items.title: 《GTA 6》在 PC 上可能会玩得最好，但在控制器上玩效果会更好
items.summary: I cannot get over all the ways Rockstar has turned a controller into an immersion tool.

content.v: I hate to credit Sony's aggressive (and presumably very expensive) marketing campaign for GTA 6—you know, the one which appeared to have also plucked the ability for Xbox to even mention the game by name. That's something I'm still shocked was even a thing anyone was allowed to do.

So I won't credit it… mostly. We all already know that PC is going to get the best version of GTA 6 when it finally hits our desktops, whenever that might be. But I am going to agree with one part of the whole "Grand Theft Auto 6 plays best on PS5" shtick: the DualSense controller. It's so good that I fear those who reach for a mouse and keyboard will be missing out on some incredible immersion.
In control

I never expected a controller to actively add to my experience, but I also forgot just how many goodies Sony stuffed into this thing. Seriously, Rockstar has taken full advantage of everything the peripheral has to offer.

I've been weaving through traffic way more in GTA 6 thanks to a huge increase in general vehicle density and some criminally narrow roads that can cause some major bottlenecks. Flooring it all the way from A to B isn't quite as easy as it used to be, which is why I kind of love how you can use the adaptive triggers to comfortably maintain a steady cruising speed before clicking it all the way in as a way to floor it. It makes my speed feel just that little more deliberate, with that tactile feel for when I really want to amp up how fast I'm going.

But driving might actually be the least interesting way Rockstar has made full use of the controller. The parts that have gotten me more than anything are the small ways haptics have been implemented to strengthen story moments or make parts of Leonida feel even more alive.

The first time I really noticed the controller was back in the beginning of the game, when I'm instructed to go and pick Lucia up from prison. As I'm standing outside as Jason, watching her emerge from the gate, the controller starts thumping just a little bit. A heartbeat. I'm literally feeling Jason's heart racing as Lucia approaches. No dialogue, no internal monologue letting me know how nervous he is. It's such a small detail, but one that massively hammed up the moment for me.

My absolute favourite way it's been implemented, though? The clubs. The goddamn clubs. Leonida's sprawling nightlife is already impressive in isolation—Hitman's Berlin level was the last time I felt this enamoured with a videogame nightclub—but this is where Rockstar went all-in on the controller's haptic feedback. Step into a club and you'll immediately feel the bass pulsating through the controller.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dtUdUWw3haf9iirzZjNTF7-1920-80.png

It's not just the same, monorhythmic beat for every song though. The bass perfectly matches the song; those long, teeth-shaking booms cut with shorter, less intense thumps. I feel like I'm back in my first year of university trying to sleep while the nearby student nightclub blasts the same songs until 3am every damn Wednesday, the bass somehow reverberating across the campus and straight through my bedframe.

When I first set foot inside the Jack of Hearts club at the beginning of Chapter 3, I was practically stunlocked by how much more immersive being able to feel the bass through the controller was making the entire experience. Seriously, I cannot overstate just how much it sucks you into what's happening around you.

These are all things that I genuinely feel folks are going to miss out on with a simple mouse and keyboard. Sure, your aiming will be better. Yes, none of the things I've described above actually change anything about the gameplay. It'll still be the same GTA 6 no matter what you play with. But for all the ways Rockstar has managed to elevate the experience and the immersion I've been feeling just through something as small as the controller I'm holding? It at least deserves consideration for your go-to playthrough peripheral.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BHPqKqLPfA5ZBPetGie6Zb-1920-80.jpg

items.title: 《侠盗猎车手 6》发布当天《周四橄榄球之夜》的收视率是整个赛季最低的
items.summary: The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out, had the lowest viewership of

content.v: The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out, had the lowest viewership of the entire season so far for a TNF game, but the low ratings might not be due entirely to competition with GTA 6.

The data shows that 12.23 million people, on average, watched the November 19 matchup between the Indianapolis Colts and Houston Texans on Prime Video. That was a 9% slide from the Week 11 Thursday Night Football matchup in 2025 featuring the New England Patriots and New York Jets.

Looking at week-over-week, the November 12 matchup this year between the Washington Commanders and New York Giants drew 16.27 million viewers , and was up 17% compared to the Week 10 matchup in 2025 featuring the Las Vegas Raiders and Denver Broncos.
Due to the poor ratings of the November 19 TNF game, the full-season average now for TNF games this season sank to 16.62 million on per game.

One expert told GameSpot that live sports like football probably won't be too heavily impacted by GTA 6 because people want to watch in real time. The low ratings for the November 19 matchup could be partially attributable to competition with GTA 6, but a likelier scenario is that people tuned out because it was a boring game in which the heavily favored Texans throttled the Colts by a score of 26-3.
The Texans were up 17-3 at the half, and the game only had nine more points total scored in the second half--all by the Texans. Not exactly thrilling stuff that people would stay glued to.

Ahead of GTA 6's launch, people also wondered how The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, which released on November 20, might be impacted. It may have been, but the film still put up massive numbers at the box office that exceeded expectations.

GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027 , as rumored.

items.title: GTA 6 和 Red Dead Redemption 共享同一个宇宙的明确证据
items.summary: Here are the seven easter eggs in GTA 6 that prove Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto take place in the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/red-dead-blog-1795529199286.jpg

From action movies to popular memes, there are dozens and dozens of Easter eggs and references to wider pop culture in GTA 6. But Rockstar has also slipped in more than a few nods to some of the studio’s previous games within Leonida. There’s a Manhunt-themed tattoo, for example, and a ludicrously convoluted secret that has already been unearthed involving a portal back to the days of Vice City. But one series is showing up more than others: Red Dead Redemption.

We’re still working our way through finding all of them, as is the rest of the internet, but so far we’ve found seven secrets that relate to the developer’s beloved Western games. From hats and guns to road names and license plates, here are seven Red Dead Easter eggs in GTA 6.
Valentine Drive
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124145128-1795534655949.jpg

If you’re looking for hidden details about Red Dead, the Western-themed Frontier Mini Golf course is a natural place to start. While none of the holes directly tell the tale of Red Dead Revolver, Red Dead Redemption, or its prequel—aside from squinting at hole four and seeing a snowy train wreck as a tangential nod to RDR2’s prologue—there are still things to find.

We’ll get on to who can be seen roaming it in a moment, but before you even set foot inside, an Easter egg can be found. That’s because the attraction itself is located on Valentine Drive, a reference to the first major town you explore in Chapter 1 of Red Dead Redemption 2’s story. This is the location where Arthur famously drinks a few too many beers, has a bit of a dance, and looks for his friend, Lenny. Sadly, alcohol doesn’t seem to be served at this Mini Golf, although there’s nothing stopping you from bringing your own six-pack in.
Tiny Arthur Morgan
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/gta-6-99-incredible-little-details-17-32-screenshot-1795534637517.png

Once you’re on the course, though, a little friend with a familiar face riding on his back may well walk up to you. A small chihuahua with a cowboy toy, dressed in remarkably similar clothing to what Red Dead Redemption 2 protagonist Arthur Morgan wore in many of the game’s trailers. Feel free to give the little guy a pet, too, and his gun-toting rider will look like he’s giving it a little “yeehaw”. Adorable.
Arthur’s Hat
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/red-dead-blog-1795534613357.jpg

Perhaps more life-sized Arthur Morgan Easter eggs are more your thing, though. Well, get yourself over to Port Gellhorn to get your hands on, and head in, one such thing. Follow the trail of signs and balloons to find a resident looking to get rid of any old tat. Hidden amongst it all, though, is a real treasure. No, not the cow-patterned Hawaiian shirt, but something that will make fans of Red Dead Redemption 2’s hearts flutter a little: a genuine cowboy hat. Not just any cowboy, either, but Arthur himself. The dark brown colour, complete with twisted rope around the rim, is unmistakable, and is now Jason or Lucia’s to wear whenever they like. An absolute bargain at $35, too.
Duke Arms
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124145822-1795534596884.jpg

As if we needed any further proof that the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption stories take place in the same universe, the Duke Arms Company cements this. At any of Leonida’s Ammu-Nation stores, you can find weapons made by the same gun company that produced the Duke 1853 Navy Revolver in Red Dead Online. On the packaging found inside GTA 6’s gun stores, you can also spot 1853 written out in Roman numerals (MDCCCLIII) on the boxes. It just can’t be a coincidence.
Flaco Hern á ndez and Blackwater
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124150135-1795534554312.jpg

“The Cowboy’s Prayer is To Die Young” is a Wild West-set novel of which you can read a few pages in GTA 6. There are a few fun little details hidden within. First, a mention of Blackwater, the port city from Red Dead Redemption and its prequel, where John Marston chooses to build his ranch near to. But there’s also a familiar name to those who chose to fully engage with RDR2’s side activities.

Flaco Hernández was an infamous outlaw who you can meet during the 2018 game’s “The Noblest of Men, and a Woman” stranger mission. At the end of that story, you knock on his cabin by Cairn Lake and defeat him in a duel. The book in GTA 6 recounts all of these details, confirming that the events of Rockstar’s Western games are canon in Grand Theft Auto lore. There are many copies of the book to be found around Leonida, but I spotted one at the Grayson Motel towards the north of the map in Lummox County.
New Austin License Plates
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/new-austin-map-1795534526098.jpg

More locations from Red Dead here, as you may have spotted some vehicles roaming around Leonida that don’t sport license plates belonging to the “Goodtime State”. In fact, some of them hail from New Austin, the sandy state in Red Dead Redemption where the likes of Armadillo, Tumbleweed, and Thieves’ Landing can be found. Unfortunately, you can’t add one of these to your own car at a GTA 6 mod shop, but you can always jack someone else’s ride if you want to pretend you’re from the cowboy-adjacent state.
Rad Dad’s Redemption Tour
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124153157-1795534499270.jpg

And finally, more of a fun wink to the camera than a full-on Easter egg, there’s a band playing live shows in Leonida that must be a fan of Rockstar’s western games. Get yourself over to the Three Sheets liquor store in the starting area of Key Lento to take a look at a poster for the Rad Dads’ show. They’re heading out on a redemption tour. Rad Dads Redemption. Red Dead Redemption. Get it? There’s not much more to say about this one than that, really.
And those are the Red Dead secrets that we’ve found so far in GTA 6. Did we miss any? Let us know in the comments.

items.title: GTA 6 有一个秘密任务，感觉就像硬目标遇见了锯子
items.summary: In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6 , you can teach one loud-mouthed hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is

content.v: In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6 , you can teach one loud-mouthed hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is the deadliest game, as this secret mission will require cunning and sharp shooting to survive. It's Hard Target meets SAW, and the victor gets a pretty sizable stack of cash. Here's how you can be the most elusive of quarry.
Go to Hyde Island
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-2.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-10.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-11.jpg?w=636

Located north of Lummox County and the Moreau River, Hyde Island is where you can start this mission. All you have to do is land on the island, and after a few steps, a dart will hit you and knock you out.
Listen to your captor's speech
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-5.jpg?w=636

Now for the boring part. You'll wake up inside of a shipping container, with a fashionable explosive necklace locked in place. Once your captor finishes his rant, the game begins, and you'll want to move .
Run to the tent directly in front of you
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-6.jpg?w=636

You'll have 10 seconds to reach a tent in front of you, where you'll find a gun and a paltry two rounds for the sidearm. After the count is up, a hunter on a quad bike will show up, and he'll be gunning for you. To make things worse, he also has a dog with him that'll track you throughout the island. Don't engage him; he's heavily armored, and two bullets aren't nearly enough to stop him—besides, you'll need those rounds for his dog, Caesar. Sorry, animal lovers.
Search for more outposts
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-7.jpg?w=636

You can find more ammo, adrenaline, and a shotgun at nearby outposts. Each one is lit up, so be fast, be sneaky, and try not to get caught. The hunter is going to be tracking you constantly, even without his dog, and he has a sniper rifle that can take you out in just a few shots if he catches you.
Prepare for a showdown
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-1.jpg?w=636

Get as much ammo as you can, and choose your spot for the last stand. The hunter's dog will be a pest, so deal with it first. It's easy to spot, with a red light on its collar. Trees also make for good cover against the hunter, so once he's in range, start nailing him with shots to critical areas. Once he stumbles, unload a few shotgun rounds and finish him off.
Collect your rewards

Once the hunter is down, search his body for the Island-Poacher FF-50 sniper rifle and ammo for it. Head west to the boathouse to reclaim your personal items and $15,000 in cash. Not a bad haul for a deadly night's work.
What happens if you fail?
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-9.jpg?w=636

If the hunter does kill you, you'll lose a chunk of cash and wake up near one of your safehouses. The good news is you can retry the mission by heading back to Hyde Island, but the bad news is you'll have to listen to the hunter's speech again.

For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub. This is constantly updated, with walkthroughs on how to play GTA 6 on your phone , how to unlock hurricanes , and how to go to hell for a fight against Satan himself.

items.title: 《质量效应》编剧表示，“作为一名粉丝，我会对他们为 ME 宇宙中的 ME3 结局提出的解决方案感到满意”
items.summary: My personal solution would be playable elcor main character. Can't go wrong with that.

content.v: Spoilers for the end of Mass Effect 3 follow, naturally.

You know what? I didn't have many questions left at the end of Mass Effect 3. Joker was a robot now. His robot girlfriend was perhaps less of a robot? Shepard converted herself into a dotfile to make the Reapers chill out, and Buzz Aldrin's talents lie in areas other than voice acting.

I had plenty of questions when BioWare announced Mass Effect 5 was gonna be a thing though. Could you really write a Mass Effect story in the radically changed galaxy we were left with at the end of Shepard's adventure? Apparently, you could. In a recent AMA on Reddit (via IGN ), BioWare writer Cat Valente wrote that the now-cancelled Mass Effect sequel's team put a lot of work into handling ME3's endings "in a way that wouldn't piss everyone off, [or] at least not piss them off completely".

The goal, says Valente, was to write a continuation of Mass Effect's narrative that "wouldn't privilege any one kind of player over another". That tracks with what we've heard before: leaks have suggested ME5 was set to more or less wrap all the previous game's endings into one (Deus Ex: Invisible War style, hell yeah).

Of course, it'd have to do that while allowing BioWare "to actually write a coherent story going forward, within the limits of having to do it in a playable mainstream videogame and not a post-modern 3000 page novel", adds Valente. "Not for nothing, guys, but that's *kind of a tall fucking order*. Part of the reason it took so long and Andromeda was in Andromeda is that figuring out an elegant solution to that problem turns out to be *really hard*".

The sheer challenge of creating a coherent, satisfying follow-up to ME3 that took into account everyone's choices had Valente, at one point, "thinking *god, if I'd known when I finished ME3 that I'd be one of the people who had to find the mops and buckets to clean up that mess...*".

Nevertheless, she reckons the studio did eventually alight on a way of handling it that made sense. "Yes, there was an answer, yes, I know it, as least inasmuch as I know what it was when I was working there… We knew all the discourse on the endings, of course we did, and I do think as a fan I would have been happy with the solution (at least what it was when I left) if I booted up the game having had nothing to do with it".

And, well, that's that. We'll never know if the internet would have been satisfied or not (though I know where I'd put my money on that question), because EA killed the project and BioWare with it , and there's rarely a follow-up to an ending like that.

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's breaking records everywhere, including at PlayStation.

The gaming giant has announced that GTA 6 is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history, a record that goes back 30+ years and five console generations. According to the gaming giant, more than 39 million unique players on PS5 have jumped into GTA 6 so far.
Here is a quick rundown of GTA 6's new records on PS5 so far (covering the November 19-22 period):

A big, record-breaking start for GTA 6 was always expected. If the game didn't break records, that would be a bigger story. Additionally, GTA 6 is an anomaly--its success will not save the AAA industry from its many serious, deep-rooted issues , experts have said, and many believe other publishers will learn all the wrong lessons.

GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027 , as rumored.

content.v: 《GTA6》藏有一处通往2002年《GTA：罪恶 都市 》的传送门彩蛋。视频展示杰森穿过传送门，进入旧作中的马里布俱乐部。进入后，场景使用了PS2时代的画面和动画风格。玩家还能在那里取得汤米·维赛迪的标志性衬衫和一辆摩托车，并将两者带回现代罪恶都市。

items.title: GTA 6 玩家正在将金钱故障优化到一英寸之内，以便在短短 10 分钟内赚取 100,000 美元
items.summary: We’ve already covered players using infinite money glitches to get rich quickly in GTA 6, but people are takin

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/vintage-vice-city-weapon-pattern-01-1795529184487.jpg

We’ve already covered players using infinite money glitches to get rich quickly in GTA 6 , but people are taking it to the next level. New money-making optimization strategies are seeing players become millionaires in a couple of hours, while still in the early game.
Instead of playing the game as intended and robbing stores, banks, and gang hideouts, some GTA 6 players are repeating the same actions over and over to generate money fast.
How to do the new GTA 6 money glitch

The new method sees players using vans and character swaps at a location in a town called Hamlet. In Hamlet, there’s an industrial area with a big warehouse outside of town, with a teddy bear van parked outside.

There are drugs inside the van outside as well as inside the warehouse itself. To do the glitch, you need to register two vans, turn up to the location, and have your partner call in a different personal vehicle while the player calls in one of the personal vans and takes the loot.

Stow the loot in the back of your personal vehicle, then drive the teddy van parked outside into the warehouse, parking it inside, on the right of the door, at which point tell your partner to wait in the car. The player then gets out and drives the teddy bear van parked inside (both of these vans are empty of loot at this point) and park this opposite the other van, so both vans have their back doors facing the shutter entrance.

Next, switch to your partner and exit the first teddy van before heading outside, where you switch back. Then ask your partner to drive the personal van loaded with all the loot. Using the partner menu, ask your partner to fence the loot, and watch them drive off to do so.

Once your partner has driven off, use the Scooter Bros app to call in the second personal van. After backing the van up to the warehouse, switch to the partner fencing the loot, before immediately switching back. This respawns both teddy bear vans and the loot inside, but it also keeps the two you moved earlier where you parked them inside and fills them with loot, essentially doubling the take.
According to one GTA 6 player who posted about this new method on Reddit , the technique earns you between $88,000-$100,000 in under 10 minutes.

Some of the replies to the Reddit post asked the OP when their in-game bank account limit will be raised, suggesting they’re still relatively early in the game. Later on, more lucrative robbery opportunities open up for players anyway, and you can pull off $100k jobs with way less hassle than this, and while having some actual fun whilst you’re at it.

The question is whether Rockstar patches early days money glitches like these out of GTA 6. GTA 6's first post-launch patch failed to take action, but I imagine it won't be long before Rockstar does something about this.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

items.title: 我看了几个小时的 GTA 6 游戏内电视节目，它们绝对狂野
items.summary: Rockstar's satire has reached new levels with in-game cartoons like Barnyard Blue and the dark comedy The Tyro

content.v: Of all the things I expected of Grand Theft Auto 6, sitting there watching in-game TV for like… two hours was not on my list. Freshly preloaded and ready to go on my Xbox Series X right at 3am on the west coast, claiming to be in New Zealand, booting it up for the first time had me rubbing my hands like Birdman – I was ready to get in the thick of it in GTA 6. What could this new Vice City's criminal underworld make me do? Not much. Will I have to survive shootouts early on, and will I need to contend with the new wanted system in a car chase? Not really. Mostly because as soon as I got to Jason's home in the opening hour, I sat my ass down on his living room couch, flipped on Weazel News and couldn't believe what I was seeing.

In GTA 6, you can sit on the couch and flip through three TV channels of original in-universe programming – full-on TV shows made for the game, existing within the fiction of its world. You have Weazel News, the nutty right-wing parody that broadcasts news segments and TV series with the production value of something we'd see in our real world. Then there's the Telemundo spoof called Megamundo that shows Spanish-language soap operas / telenovelas, but with the absurdity cranked up several notches. Lastly, there's the Visit Leonida channel that's dedicated to advertising tourist attractions and businesses across this fictional rendition of Florida, satirizing modern economics and business.

And no, these are not channels with maybe a couple minutes' worth of gags to see once and move on from – these act as legit television programming, shows with multiple episodes that go on for six to eight minutes each. Why would I flip through my free Roku channels or be hit with choice paralysis on my own TV's built-in streaming apps when GTA 6 could rapid fire some of the wildest shit the series has done with shows you'd never see on real TV?

I'd get a kick out of Alan Wake 2's Koskela Brothers commercials or Max Payne's Adventures of Captain Baseball Bat Boy episodes, which aligned with Remedy's style and universe. But it's kind of astonishing that GTA 6's level of production value for in-game entertainment would rival or exceed cable TV – if someone was going to do it, though, it'd be Rockstar.

Weazel is by far the most intricate channel, weaving in anchored news segments and on-the-ground reporting that take ridiculous right-wing talking points and conspiracy theories to seed its own brand of misinformation across Leonida. In between these reports are legitimately produced TV shows to further clown on this type of extremist politics through shock humor.

Barnyard Blue is straight-up cop propaganda masked as a children's cartoon with an aggressive blonde child partnering with anthropomorphic animals "solving" crimes on a farm, clearly satirizing police brutality and abuse of power by law enforcement you see in the real world. One episode ends with the child monologuing the lesson, "Don't question authority silly! Respect the chain of command like your life depends on it, and one day, you'll be the law and can do, well, pretty much anything you like!"

Right Wing is an Adult Swim-style animated superhero series where the titular eagle-themed "hero" tries "saving America" from its "societal ills" – it highlights the projection and hypocrisy of modern conservative politics with regard to LGBTQ+, but done in such an over-the-top and comedic fashion that either has me cringing or cracking up. In one episode, a villain called "The Flamer" captures the President and has him tied up and in a ball gag. Right Wing gets word about the situation from inside a gay club and exclaims, "Repression builds character, dammit! Not on my watch!" He then busts into the Oval Office, confronting The Flamer with, "Get your beautifully manicured hands off the President!" In an attempt to save the President from being kissed by The Flamer, he dives in and ends up kissing The Flamer.

The Johnsons is another animated series made in the vein of Family Guy that centers around a family of… anthropomorphic (?)... penises… who try adjusting to a new community full of free-spirited neighbors, and highlights the absurdity of social conservatism. You'll see husband and wife Hugh and Wanda meet their new neighbors who are a couple they mistakenly think are inviting them to a sex party and end up at a very normal get-together in BDSM gear. "She shows me she loves me by stuffing my nuts into a little bird cage, but that's us. The important thing is remembering why you fell in love in the first place," the neighbors conclude. To which Hugh tells Wanda, "Oh honey, you know I'd let you rearrange my balls like origami anytime."

Then there's The Tyrone Show which is a mockumentary-style sitcom about Tyrone and his increasingly ridiculous, unhinged dating life in Vice City – it's meant to mock the modern dating scene in cities like Miami and takes cues from The Vince Staples show. With the slapstick, hostile nature, I'm still trying to work out whether its satire is problematic, hilarious, or mean-spirited, or all of those things in combination, and maybe that's the point? All I know is the acting performances are incredible and I can't look away, and maybe that's also the point.

Trying to gauge Rockstar-style satire and whether or not its commentary is poignant, that's something we'll probably be stewing on for a good long while. Regardless, there's no denying that this is the studio's biggest effort building out an in-world fiction. The Megamundo telenovelas got crazy twists that put those reruns of Cuna de Lobos in the background of my grandma's house to shame.

The Visit Leonida channel features PSAs from the state government to warn them about wildlife outbreaks and the governor's pretty fucked-up crusade against furries. Those are interstitials between hysterical ad spots for the likes of car detailing shops, restaurants, and lawyers that spoof on American commercials for genuine laugh-out-loud moments. Tourism stingers poke at glorifying gentrification, overindulgence, and ads that play on selling working-class people on faux lavish lifestyles. Of course, GTA's advantage is not having to abide by FCC regulations, and that it's a video game after all – you can mock your audience all you want.

Vice City being based on Miami, GTA 6 is sprinkled with Cuban culture and brushes right up on the line of stereotypes. One commercial rapidly fires off all the services immigrants may need – "Need a notarized affidavit for your cousin's immigration papers? Boom. And we got pin pan puns, too! (Aye coño!) A new ID and a set of 26-inch rims? Hit up 'I Know A Guy'" If you're from this part of the world, these jokes do play into something very familiar to us (and referencing a pin pan pun tells me someone Cuban definitely wrote this commercial).

As our GTA 6 reviewer Luke Reilly said , there are many, many distractions, most of which are great. In my early hours in Leonida, watching TV has been the greatest one yet, and it's going to be tough to top. So, if you have some downtime between missions, housework, errands, or heists, check out GTA 6's TV shows for the dark realization of how our world is a real messed-up place, but one where you may as well get some laughs out of it along the way.

items.title: 乐高首个 Marvel Rivals 套装由 495 块积木组成，向游戏中最可爱的恐怖角色致敬
items.summary: Next month marks the second anniversary of Marvel Rivals , and to celebrate, a new Lego set is on the way that

content.v: Next month marks the second anniversary of Marvel Rivals , and to celebrate, a new Lego set is on the way that lets you build the game's unofficial mascot, Jeff the Land Shark. While we regularly see Lego Marvel sets roll out, this is the first-ever Marvel Rivals kit, and it'll go on sale starting January 1, 2027, priced at $50. GameSpot can also exclusively reveal the first images of Jeff below, showing the completed build alongside his box art.

The 495-piece set captures the adorable strategist in all his glory, including his big eyes, toothy smile, huge tongue, and even his collar. This won't be a static figure either: once fully assembled, Jeff has a movable head, legs, tail, and fins that let builders recreate his joyful trot, swimming, and battle poses. For added touches, his collar includes his signature name tag, his tongue can be removed to close his mouth, and his fin can be detached so builders can replicate Jeff's Hide-and-Seek movement ability from the game.

"Jeff brings together everything players love about a breakout gaming character: an unforgettable silhouette, a personality you understand instantly, and the ability to turn any match into a story," Lego Marvel design lead Jesper C. Nielsen said in a press release. "We wanted this Lego model to capture both sides of him, from the lovable companion fans want beside their screen to the unpredictable strategist they meet in battle."

Meanwhile, Jeff and the rest of the Marvel Rivals roster are preparing to cap off an entire year of Avengers-centric events that have been building up to the game's big Avengers: Doomsday tie-in. Season 11.5 kicks off on December 11. Nightcrawler was recently added to the game, bringing mutant energy, swords, and teleportation strategies, and he'll soon be followed by Marvel's unique take on Dracula, who has spent the last few months hibernating and healing for the battles ahead.

items.title: 如何通过 Xbox 上的远程游戏在 PC 或手机上玩 GTA 6
items.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming , and Microsoft has also now confirmed sup

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming , and Microsoft has also now confirmed support for Remote Play on Xbox. This means you can play GTA 6 on your PC, smartphone, or a device like Xbox Rog Ally.
Remote Play is an Xbox service that lets you stream games from your Xbox Series X|S to a device you might already have, and it's easy to get working.
From your console, select Settings then Devices & connections then Remote features . From there, check the box for Enable remote features .
Xbox Remote Play also has a "test" feature so you can preview the experience in your home environment before going further.

From there, you can play GTA 6 from a mobile device by accessing the Xbox Remote Play website , selecting the console you want to connect to, and then the device. To play GTA 6 on your PC or Xbox Rog Ally, users can open the Xbox app for PC, click on their profile, then select Accessories & Remote Play and then select Remote Play to choose the device to play on.

Additionally, people have spotted that GTA 6's store page on the PlayStation Store now mentions that Remote Play is supported and that PlayStation 5 and PlayStation Portal owners can use cloud streaming if they have a Premium membership.

Right now, you need a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S to stream GTA 6, but some are dreaming of the day when you can simply stream the game to your PC or phone without any expensive hardware. That day may eventually come for GTA 6, as Take-Two's own CEO has said the rising cost of gaming hardware is not a good thing and that streaming games could be a big business very soon.

“If you believe in streaming, and to be clear, we really do, and I’m happy to put a timeline on it. I think we’ll be in commercial streaming mode within three years, and by commercial, I mean low latency," Strauss Zelnick said. "That can 10x the effective installed base. Now, it doesn’t mean we’re going to 10x our revenue–and we wouldn’t project that we would–but because obviously your avid consumers already had access to video game machines. But I do think it creates great opportunity for titles that are broadly desirable, even outside of core markets.”
GTA 6 is doing just fine without the potential expanded reach of streaming. After all, the game sold 32.5 million copies before launch and generated close to $4 billion in revenue by day one.

Even if GTA 6 doesn't add support for full streaming without a console, the game is expected to expand its reach in a major way in 2027 with an expected PC release. Beyond that, GTA 6 is reportedly going to add an online mode in 2027 as well, and it could be bigger than Fortnite .

content.v: Battlestate Games已开始推送《 逃离塔科夫 》1.3.5.0补丁。游戏迁移至虚幻6，并引入用于图形和视觉效果的RenderStack。更新改善了瞄具画面，缓解了举枪瞄准时的帧率下跌，同时加快了突袭中因服务器或网络异常掉线后的重连。

开发团队在补丁说明中表示，工程师此前花了数月分析性能并改写关键系统，本次更新的部分性能改善来自这些独立开展的代码优化。Unity 6则为后续实现DirectX 12、FSR 4.0和DLSS帧生成提供了所需的开发工具。

items.title: 《魔兽世界：永远》周末一直在寻找 bug 和金币探索，现在发现 Sunder Armor 可能不起作用
items.summary: Lightning and sunder.

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever 's absolutely had me enthralled, as per my review (and about 220+ hours of my actual life), but that's not to say there aren't issues. Over the weekend and going on into this week, Blizzard's had to play whack-a-mole with both exploits and what appears to be a long-standing bug affecting one of the tanking classes' core mechanics.

First, those exploits—players discovered that lockboxes contained a sort of quantum loot, in that the actual roll of the lockboxes seemed tied to the player peeking inside of them, rather than what was inside regardless. If you turned off auto-loot, you can open a lockbox without actually pulling the loot into your bag. Then, if you sent that lockbox to another player via mail, they'd get something different.

Essentially, players could simply play a game of mass pass-the-parcel to ensure favorable lockbox results, further busting up the economy after the Blackmaw Hold drama earlier this month. That's since been hotfixed , simply disabling the mechanic, with a more elegant solution to come further down the road: "Today, we’re working on a proper fix that restores the ability to peek and partially loot lockboxes, and makes them otherwise work as intended."

Meanwhile, the Obsidian Sentinel in Uldaman was briefly rendered lootless. As spotted by WoWHead , players could hop into the dungeon and repeatedly rinse the boss to grab a cheeky 18 or so gold in 15 minutes by vendoring the loot as a max-level character.

While that's not really game-breaking (instance lockouts are limited to five per hour), if you had an organised group of level 60s all funnelling gold to the same guy—like, say, if you were a streamer with a dedicated fanbase that didn't mind wasting a quarter of an hour, or if you were a large-scale RMT operation—there's a bigger problem.
That lootless state turned out to be a band-aid, as Blizzard simply lowered the vendor costs later.

Perhaps the biggest hiccup over the past weekend, though, is the fact that Sunder Armor (and other armor-reducing effects like faerie fire) very well might just not do anything. I hopped in-game to test it on my warrior and saw no noticeable difference between Sunder Armor in both dungeons and the overworld while fighting lower level targets, though my testing capabilities were limited solo, since armor is affected by the level of whoever's attacking the target: And if I rock up to an on-level elite in a dungeon at 60, I tend to die before I can get a good sample.

Fortunately, I don't need to be too thorough. There's a lot more comprehensive math and log-testing on this github post : "Once an armor debuff goes on, players' and pets' hits barely move, same as the report says. About 5% of the armor drop actually shows up in the damage, and more stacks don't help." The evidence is all pretty convincing.

While those other exploits are annoying oopsies, arguably just a result of players—who find edge cases like water finds cracks—stress-testing the system? The Sunder Armor bug is sort of huge, since that's one of the protection warrior's main group utilities (aside from being a tanky meatshield). It still appears to be filling its primary role of threat generation, but: Yikes.
There's no mention of it in the hotfixes , but I'll update this article if one pops up in the coming days.

items.title: 作者说，《质量效应宇宙》将回答三部曲的结局问题和队友的命运
items.summary: BioWare's canceled Mass Effect Universe would have addressed Mass Effect 3's controversial endings and the fat

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/06/masseffect-1793984731251.jpg
BioWare's canceled Mass Effect Universe would have addressed Mass Effect 3's controversial endings and the fates of Shepard's squadmates, one of the game's writers has said.

For more than a decade, Mass Effect fans have debated how BioWare could reconcile the wildly divergent endings of Mass Effect 3 — and satisfy players who insisted that their particular ending choice should be canon (I see you, Destroy fans). But according to one of the writers behind the now-canceled Mass Effect Universe, the studio had actually cracked the puzzle before EA scrapped the project and closed BioWare forever.

Speaking during a reddit fan Q&A supporting the "Save Mass Effect" fan movement, Mass Effect: Annihilation novel author Cat Valente — who spent three years on the writing team for the unfinished sequel — offered a bittersweet glimpse into how the narrative team approached the franchise's biggest lingering questions.

While strict NDAs signed with published EA continue to prevent Valente from revealing specific plot details, she emphasized that reconciling Mass Effect 3's endings was front and center for the game's writers room, and noted that the team wasn't relying on a single silver bullet to bridge the 600-year narrative gap between the original trilogy and this upcoming fifth installment.

"[We] worked specifically, and for a very long and laborious time, on handling the endings in a way that wouldn't piss everyone off, at least not piss them off completely, that wouldn't make them feel like nothing mattered, wouldn't privilege any one kind of player over another, but also allow us, somehow, to actually write a coherent story going forward, within the limits of having to do it in a playable mainstream video game and not a post-modern 3000 page novel," Valente wrote.

"Not for nothing, guys, but that's *kind of a tall f***ing order*. Part of the reason it took so long and Andromeda was in Andromeda is that figuring out an elegant solution to that problem turns out to be *really hard.* An elegant solution that we can do with current game tech, that will be approved by higher-ups, that doesn't take over the whole game and make actually telling a story impossible... it takes a long time, and it's not obvious how best to pull it off when you're the people who bear responsibility for pulling off one of, if not the, hardest nut to crack in game writing.

"And it's become really clear that it's impossible to make the gaming community completely happy with anything no matter how hard you try, especially the ME endings that were so controversial, yet people feel so strongly about their own choices. We burned out so many valuable neurons going up against that problem. I know so many people think it's easy, just make Destroy canon and move on, but consider that, for example, I feel as strongly about Synthesis as others do about Destroy. And everyone feels strongly about choices mattering. Do you really think there is a single solution that would have satisfied everyone? In a *video game*?
"But we did our best, and I think we landed in a good place," she concluded. "There wasn't one single solution, but several working together, and unfortunately I can't say any more than that."

As a hugely knowledgeable fan of the original trilogy — enough that she got the gig writing Andromeda's quarian ark prequel novel — Valente emphasized that the fates of the trilogy's loyal squadmates had also been a key consideration for the Mass Effect Universe team.

"You would have been able to know everything you wanted to know about them," she said, when asked for her own thoughts of what characters such as Garrus, Tali and Wrex did next. "I don't have headcanons about those fates, I have canon-canons. I know you'd have been able to find out about them because one of my jobs was to write all those fates and their possible variations (all then submitted to the room, workshopped with everyone, and sent to higher-ups for approval...)

"God, it was like being asked to stitch a nice border on the Shroud of Turin," she continued. "I put on my Big Writer Pants for that one and gave it every bit of talent I have, because I love those characters beyond measure, and they more than earned my best."

Of course, we know that Universe would have seen at least one fan-favorite character return: Liara, now 600 years older — around middle age for a long-lived asari. But what about others? Asked for specifics, Valente noted her NDA blocked her from confirming specific names, but that there had been widespread discussion of bringing back every character possible.

"I think the best way to answer your question is to say that any character who physically *could* survive, we considered allowing to survive into the new game and made decisions on them," Valente teased. "We thought about all the things you'd have wanted us to think about, and I hope you do believe that, because it's the truth. Everyone in that room loved those characters, or loved to hate them, as much as any fan. We took each and every one of them and their fates very seriously."

So, who could have survived? Alongside the asari, the krogan are another long-lived Mass Effect species — and some fans believe we already got a glimpse at an older Grunt in the krogan civil war artwork released by BioWare a couple of years ago. Could Wrex also still be around? While he'd be ancient, it would not be impossible. Synthetic characters like EDI could certainly be around (and even if you'd picked Destroy, could surely have been rebooted eventually from a backup).

And then there are the characters and plotlines from Andromeda — a game that's nowhere near as beloved as the original Mass Effect trilogy, but whose storyline was still expected to factor into Universe in some way. Indeed, Valente revealed, Andromeda fans would have finally gained the answer to some of the spinoffs lingering questions (which were originally set to be answered in long-scrapped Andromeda sequels). For example, fans would have finally learned the identity of The Benefactor, who funded the Milky Way galaxy's push to Andromeda for unclear reasons.

"There is an answer, and it was fucking rad," Valente said. "As the author of an Andromeda tie-in, I and one of the other writers [...] worked closely on closing out Andromeda mysteries and bringing it together with the rest of the story. We know who [The Benefactor] was. At least the six of us in the writers' room know, plus anyone who approved our narratives or saw our work in-progress. I wish I could tell you, sorry."

Finally, and least surprisingly, Valente confirmed that Universe would have featured new aliens alongside the returning characters/races from the four games so far. (Would the bird-like raloi finally have appeared on-screen? We will now never know.)

"I don't think there's a problem with saying of course there were going to be new aliens?" Valente concluded. "We all pitched new species and some were accepted and moved along to art etc and some weren't. Same with the squad. All of us pitched squad members and our directors chose between the pitches. I can't give you any more than that."

items.title: 据报道 Xbox Project Helix 旨在让在线多人游戏免费
items.summary: For years, most multiplayer games on Xbox consoles required a subscription to go online. From Xbox Live to Xbo

content.v: For years, most multiplayer games on Xbox consoles required a subscription to go online. From Xbox Live to Xbox Game Pass, Microsoft paywalled multiplayer on its platforms, but the company reportedly aimed to break down that barrier for its next-gen console, Project Helix.

According to Windows Central , Project Helix was conceived under the previous Xbox leadership team as the device that would bridge the divide between PC and console gaming. Like the Asus Xbox ROG Ally PC handhelds, the console is said to have an Xbox-inspired interface and full PC game support through storefronts like Steam. Because of that design decision, it's claimed it didn't make sense to continue with paid multiplayer, since that service is free for games purchased on PC platforms like Steam and the Epic Games Store.

As the Windows Central report noted, that was reportedly the plan before Xbox leadership was shaken up and gaming hardware prices rose during the AI boom. With Asha Sharma now in charge of Xbox, the gaming division is more focused on profitability, and Microsoft's gaming arm has seen sweeping changes.

Mass layoffs and studio divestitures occurred throughout 2026, and Project Helix could be a very expensive family of devices. If Microsoft ditches paid multiplayer, it loses a revenue stream for its next-gen push at a time when component prices have risen steeply.

As part of its 25th anniversary celebrations , Microsoft also teased a few more details about Project Helix, calling it specifically "a console" that plays games from your PC, not "a PC that can also play console games."

"When we think about Project Helix, it’s really designed to be the ultimate gaming machine--one that removes all the barriers of play that have historically existed," VP of next-gen Jason Ronald said.

items.title: Steam 今年第二次改造其市场
items.summary: Big news for the skin barons in your life.

content.v: If you're normal, you probably never think about the Steam community market. If you're like me, you only touch it to sell the mountains of trading cards you get from idling . If you're a true lunatic, you're running a roaring trade in Counter-Strike 2 skins and are either unfathomably rich or trapped in a life of penury.

Either way, some news: Valve has been tinkering at the Steam marketplace again, and in an update yesterday announced a rebuilt market home page that's slightly more pleasant to handle and look at, while being more personalised to the games you're actually playing. This is in addition to a set of changes to the market Valve released (in beta) back in May .

The new market home is, says Valve, faster to load up, but it's not just a new gloss of paint. It's swapped out the pre-update Popular Items section—which mostly just showed a list of CS2 crates—for new Trending Items lists that show the popular market items for games you've actually been playing. When I look at it, I see Path of Exile, Warframe, Crisis In The Kremlin, and, uh, Dota 2. I've never touched Dota 2 in my life, so not sure what's happening there, but you get the idea.

You've also now got a watchlist that will let you keep track of various market items across multiple games. You can save specific items, a general item type, or even a particular search. I imagine this will be useful to those of you who play the Steam market like an '80s Wall Street guy shouting into a big phone.

The biggest change for me personally—that's why people read the news, for the biggest changes for me personally—is streamlined selling and relisting. You can now change the price of items you have listed for sale without laboriously taking them down and relisting them. You can just update the price tag and have done with it. Similarly, if you're selling directly from the Steam mobile app, you'll be able to approve those sales via a pop-up rather than navigating to the confirmation page. This is truly huge news for the weirdest guys you know (me).

All that aside, the market home page will now also track your in-progress badges, and search results now have a list view. There are a few more new things, but Valve confined them to an 'and finally' set of bulletpoints, so here they are in their original bulletpoint form.

content.v: 昨晚英伟达宣布，在与黄仁勋进行一系列讨论和会议后，一致投票决定恢复其职务。自即日起，黄仁勋已重新担任公司总裁兼首席执行官及董事会成员。自2026年11月12日辞去相关职务后，经过11天多方拉锯，黄仁勋上演“王者归来”。如果有留意过去这段时间的新闻，特别是来自英伟达员工的呼声，就知道黄仁勋在公司内部的影响力究竟有多大。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795517822_530445_jpg_r.jpg
在官方宣布新的决定后，黄仁勋也第一时间重返英伟达总部，提前在门口守候的大批员工鼓掌并高呼黄仁勋名字，现场欢呼声与掌声不断。黄仁勋也向在场的英伟达员工致谢，感谢大家给予的第二次机会，承诺在第二个任期内会做得更好，成为一名更出色的首席执行官。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795529428_372095_jpg_r.jpg
有趣的是，这次回归黄仁勋并没有身穿标志性的黑色皮夹克，而是换成了行政夹克。 另外黄仁勋表示，第一天上班还没有电脑，IT部门需要提供一台新电脑，希望能有一台RTX Spark。
这也是一个很有意思的表达，因为RTX Spark是黄仁勋辞职之前，英伟达发布的最后一款重点产品，专为打造个人AI的Windows 11 PC而生。在今年10月初，黄仁勋还与微软首席执行官Satya Nadella一起出席了RTX Spark的发布会。
RTX Spark主要由英伟达与联发科合作开发的Grace CPU + Blackwell RTX GPU组成，采用台积电3nm工艺制造，AI性能达到1petaFLOP，能够本地运行高达200B参数的AI模型。其提供了两种形态，一种是笔记本电脑另一种则是紧凑型桌面主机，过去一个月里都已上市销售了。

items.title: 为什么《侠盗猎车手 6》受到评论轰炸？
items.summary: Why GTA 6 user reviews are so low: Metacritic review-bombing explained.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/gta-6-jason-and-lucia-cigar-1795473956655.jpg

GTA 6 tied with the original version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the highest-scored game in history based on Metacritic ratings, sitting pretty at a 99 critic score. Rarely do we see something earn this kind of unanimous praise, but our reviewer Luke Reilly would agree , giving GTA 6 a coveted score of 10 on our scale and calling it “the single most impressive video game I have ever played." However, you may have heard about the wide discrepancy between the critic's metascore and the user score — as of publishing this, GTA 6 has a 5.7/10 average from well over 100,000 user reviews. Why is that?

User scores on Metacritic are under far, far (and I mean far ) less scrutiny, allowing everyone and anyone to post their own review and score regardless of how much of the game they've actually played. This isn't anything new, and it’s been around on other sites that aggregate scores from the audience (like Rotten Tomatoes or an older version of GameSpot I used to use as a kid). As a result, you're likely to see more outliers or trolling, but mostly users who shoot from the hip to let their voice be heard. That leaves things susceptible to review bombing – typically, a wave of reactionary people who have motives beyond evaluating a game for what it is.

There are reviews that appear to have legitimate concerns, mentioning that GTA 6 might not be for them or align with their tastes. Among those concerns are a slow start that emphasizes slice-of-life style activities before action starts to pick up, dissatisfaction with the interactive layers for simple tasks, the frame rate being capped at 30fps, or a general disinterest in what it's trying to do as an open-world action game. Maybe it didn't live up to their perceived "hype" with 13 years between series entries. However, you might be wondering why GTA 6 is the latest subject of what's clearly motivated review bombing with tons of "0" scores from a reactionary crowd.

I'm not going to pretend to give credence to clearly disingenuous reviews, but if you are genuinely curious, there are a significant number of reviews that decry GTA 6 for being "too woke" and a, uh, "cuck simulator” — the most unserious people, the incel crowd coming out of the woodwork, trying to fight a weird culture war over a game they likely either did not play or have barely played. GTA has always parodied the most ridiculous parts of American culture, and GTA 6 is no exception — now the primary targets of that satire are crying about it.

I don't think I need to explain what it means to be a "cuck" or the concept of cuckoldry, but by definition, it has nothing to do with anything that happens to you or that you have to do in GTA 6. And perhaps the most telling part of it all is the complaints of "woke" (another term that has been ground to a point of no meaning, co-opted by right-wing extremists to label anything they deem politically progressive).

In large part, GTA 6 is telling a love story where two partners, the protagonists Jason and Lucia, have a believable relationship on-screen with corresponding gameplay elements in addition to their Bonnie and Clyde-esque crime sprees. Maybe you don't want to put up drywall, renovate your house, or run errands in early missions, but what you're about to read is more telling about the kind of people review-bombing the game than the content of the game itself.

Sift through the negative reviews on Metacritic and it's a trove of entries that read, "Everything that represents the woke culture don’t deserve nothing, other than zero." Or, "GTA 6 is way too woke for my taste." And other variations on one that reads, "Graphics fantastic, besides that a cuckhold [sic] game, and really woke!" One just spams the word "woke" while several are straight gibberish or admittance that they did not play the game.

One entry reads, "I already have an annoying gf in real life and you want me to deal with it in the game again???????", while another says, "No hookers, no freedom, No action, Just cuck simulator, Please woke community, leave Rockstar games alone." And (sorry) one more for the road: "The plot is boring, and the main characters are a simp and a stereotypical ‘strong woman.’ They have absolutely no charisma; the game is packed with a one-sided agenda, and the trolling of ‘libturds’ is dull and predictable."

Amid this all, Metacritic has some measures in place to moderate fake reviews — it removed user reviews that went live before the game even released . And its 36-hour rule has been in place for a while where user reviews can't go up until a day-and-a-half has passed from a game's public release. Moderators also have the ability to stamp out reviews that violate Metacritic's guidelines, but with well over 100,000 of them up now, it's a gargantuan task.

While that crowd continues to be petty, whatever dent they think they're making isn't visible, as publisher Take-Two Interactive reported $3.79 billion in revenue with approximately 32.5 million units sold by launch day. Rockstar is going to be fine. Like the game or not, outrage fatigue is settling in; this perceived culture war is as meaningless as it's ever been, and it's best to pay it no mind to save yourself from the psychic damage.

Are you playing Rockstar's blockbuster, just getting started, or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

items.title: 为了回到英伟达，黄仁勋都做了哪些“坏事”？
items.summary: 一位明显受惊的英伟达高管说

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
可惜了，兄弟，可惜。
我本来只差一个面试， 就能成为英伟达的CEO，给大伙带去最新最便宜最适合打游戏的超级显卡，造福所有游戏玩家。
但......一个穿皮衣的老头突然半路杀出来导致我终面没过。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/16851.jpg
我听说他叫黄仁勋，是个“十恶不赦”的人，有多过分呢？他玩海克斯第一件出收集者，打五号位硬憋点金手，《战舰世界》只开潜水艇，《逃离塔科夫》D2摔炮蹲撤离点......
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/20983.jpg
那很“十恶不赦”了
与此同时，他还是英伟达的前CEO。
哦不好意思，今天我们可以把“前”去掉了，11月23日，英伟达董事会正式确认同意黄仁勋恢复原职。
在“出轨风波”离职的短短十一天后，老黄回到了他忠实的英伟达。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/30606.jpg
大伙都觉得，这背后肯定有华盛顿政客之间的利益博弈，科技巨头们的互相拉扯，华尔街资本对AI生意的再判断......但我觉得，其实真相可能很简单——
在离职的这段时间里，老黄在外头把各类圈子得罪了个遍，以至于没人愿意要，把他“退货”回了英伟达。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/31400.jpg
冷知识，其实黄仁勋并没有干过我上面所说的那些“缺德”事。如今中文互联网上到处都是这样的图其实只是大伙在玩梗罢了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/31928.jpg
我去，不早说
公式很简单，你只需要贴上红色小字的栏目名，排出黑色加粗的“英伟达董事会调查发现......”样式的雷霆大标题模仿外媒刻板印象，就可以大大方方在下面附一张黄仁勋的大脸，编造老黄在玩什么游戏时干了什么缺德事的定型文了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/45744.jpg
至于内容，要做到最大程度上惹怒目标玩家的同时，与真实世界毫无关系。玩RPG游戏摇轮椅，玩竞技游戏当瘤子，玩合作游戏净捣乱，如果你的游戏里有著名畜生玩法的话就更好了。
直接化作黑锅往老黄头上扣就完事了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/46202.jpg
“这帮中国网友一直产出这种定型文，搞得我们CEO只会玩轮椅当瘤子一样”一名明显受惊的英伟达高管说道。
玩海克斯大乱斗先出收集者K队友人头，玩《DOTA2》当酱油憋点金手偷吃野，玩《猎杀对决》蹲在草里打消音臭狙，玩《Apex》开“会员制餐厅”恶心对手，玩卫戍协议卖牌升本漏怪给队友......
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/48186.jpg
怎么这么坏啊......
在这些梗图里，黄仁勋的形象可谓是“恶贯满盈”，但你又能肯定，他没有真的做过这些事。
当然，也有“黄仁勋吃饺子蘸白糖，往肠粉上浇奶茶”这种更“大众（？）”的玩法，但介于最关心老黄和英伟达现状，还乐意玩梗整蛊的大部分都是游戏玩家，这种定型文内容也是游戏偏多。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/49779.jpg
如此“坏事做尽”的黄仁勋，在放假哦不对，是被开除的这几天搅得各个游戏圈乌烟瘴气，所以，为什么就不能是玩家群体一致投票表决同意，把老黄发射回英伟达了呢？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/52710.jpg
可耻的婚姻背叛者对其所作所为供认不讳。
危害国家安全的皮衣恶魔已被赶出芯片巨头。
颇具争议的科技巨头创始人用微波炉热剩饭。
前CEO化身踹哈毒瘤玩家肆虐各大游戏圈。
我们敬爱的黄仁勋先生，在结束《GTA6》的休假后，于昨日回到了他忠诚的英伟达！
是啊，老黄离职的那段时间《GTA6》刚好发售，为什么不能是他给自己放了个游戏假呢？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261124_hzf_653_3/60876.jpg
所以，这个梗到底是怎么在短短几天内火起来的呢？由于黄仁勋离职，定型文扩散和黄仁勋回归三件事接连发生在拢共不超过半个月的时间内，可能的事实其实也很容易查证。
在老黄出轨风波爆发，卸任英伟达CEO后，纽约时报发了这样一篇文章：《威胁、辱骂与和解：黄仁勋如何让羞辱员工成为常态》，据传文章罗列了许多黄仁勋在任职期间的暴君行为。
然而内容，则是一些看上去有点无足轻重的事情，比如骂人，当着下属的面辱骂他们的领导，威胁要把员工的头盖骨掀开往里撒尿......先不说是不是真的，就算是，这似乎也无法让老黄身败名裂，至少不如婚外情那么重量级。
如此大张旗鼓地控诉一位功高权重的CEO辱骂下属，颇有种“没挖出更劲爆的黑料先用这个凑合一下吧”的诙谐感。
理所当然地，这种“欲加之罪”的行为招致了外网社区的强烈吐槽：没准哪天挖出来黄仁勋在办公室热饭也要成为黑点了。
是的，或许这才是这个梗图最初的样子
于是，如此黑色幽默且“似曾相识”的行为触发了中国网友们的“串子雷达”，一件接着一件在打游戏时“无足轻重”的小事，成为了老黄的“黑料”。
在黄仁勋恢复原职之后，这个梗甚至还迎来了“反转术式”，大伙又把那些游戏中的团队行为硬吹成是老黄重回英伟达的原因，比如玩海克斯主动出重伤和破盾，玩《杀戮尖塔2》主动抓“相信着你”......
怎么这么好啊......
哦对了，引起此次舆论事件，导致黄仁勋CEO风评被害的“纽约时报撰稿人”找到了@带带大师兄。
是的，熟悉几年前互联网氛围的人都对这一切感到十分眼熟，把各种与其本人毫不相干的“坏事”扣到其人头上玩梗。
这tm不就是“孙笑川都干了哪些坏事”吗？
虽然孙笑川撞断不周山，建造酒池肉林，一手促成了焚书坑儒成了罄竹难书的千古罪人，跟老黄到各个游戏里摇轮椅当瘤子完全不是一个量级，但二者的荒诞性，却是异曲同工的。
这些对老黄的“指控”普遍是各个游戏圈中，最招人烦，但是又不违反规则的玩法，突出一个罪不至此的同时罪无可恕，明明所有人都知道“老黄玩游戏当瘤子”是玩家们杜撰的，但这同时不妨碍大伙对这种行为恨得咬牙切齿。
更幽默的则是：被指控内容与指控形式之间的巨大反差，前者有多无足轻重，后者的大张旗鼓就有多诙谐。
我们越是一本正经地控诉老黄玩游戏不当人，控诉这个行为本身就越可笑，控诉行为本身越可笑，就越显得连“骂员工”都要挖出来当老黄黑料的“纽约时报”像个小丑。
与此同时，玩梗的大伙就是看不惯国外主流媒体对老黄事无巨细地口诛笔伐，他们一向擅长使用这招，先确定某个人或者某件事物的“负面特性”，然后疯狂寻找可能的证据往上硬凑。
当你得罪了老美，连拉屎没擦干净屁股都能成为黑料。
这就让“董事会调查黄仁勋”梗在不真实的荒诞性上又多了一层反讽的正义性。网友们正是在通过这种方式表达对外媒的离谱报道的抗议。
他们可以说功高望重的黄仁勋骂员工间接导致了他被开除，我们就能说老黄在APEX里玩滋崩，他们试图用这种细枝末节的指控将“黄仁勋罪有应得”盖棺定论，我们就可以用“老黄在磔罚森林堵萌新”把棺材板解构......
至于老黄是不是真的干了，我不道啊？

items.title: GTA6曼迪替换露西娅Mod都有了 PC版才刚起步
items.summary: 近日，一位海外玩家在社交平台分享了一张GitHub项目截图，并配文调侃：《GTA6》的PC版exe才刚出现，玩家就已经在制作将露西娅替换成…

content.v: 近日，一位海外玩家在社交平台分享了一张GitHub项目截图，并配文调侃：《GTA6》的PC版exe才刚出现，玩家就已经在制作将露西娅替换成曼迪的MOD了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611241928016463.png
从截图来看，名为ItsNotRexed的开发者在GitHub上公开了《GTA6》的MOD项目，其中除了第一人称视角MOD外，还出现了一个名为“mandy_prison_intro”的文件夹，似乎是围绕曼迪角色替换制作的相关内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611241928181135.png
目前仅凭截图还无法确认该MOD是否已经完成，也不能确定最终替换效果。
曼迪是《GTA6》中一名会在游戏初期登场的女性角色。她曾主动向杰森示好，甚至换上比基尼试图吸引他的注意，不过杰森并没有接受她的示好。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611241928328627.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611241928346943.png
相比之下，露西娅才是与杰森共同展开故事的女主角，也是玩家熟悉的核心角色。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611241928567322.png
目前游戏发售早期，网上已经出现了不少关于两名女性角色外貌的讨论，部分玩家认为曼迪比露西娅更性感、更有吸引力，于是便有人着手制作曼迪替换露西娅的MOD。
《GTA6》全收集地图上线 ，看它开局就能赚两万多，所有收集品、高跟鞋俱乐部、隐藏彩蛋位置都在这！
https://imgs.gamersky.com/upimg/new_preview/2026/11/20/origin_202611200954402940.jpg

items.title: GTA 6 Hacker 发布了完整的 Xbox 版本，PC 改装者已经在尝试让它运行
items.summary: Infamous GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek resurfaced last week , threatening to release a crucial file for the Xbox buil

content.v: Infamous GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek resurfaced last week , threatening to release a crucial file for the Xbox build of GTA 6 that could be used to create an unofficial PC port of the game. The hacker originally promised to publicly drop the .exe file for this version of the game depending on whether their memecoin hit a certain market cap, and has been taunting publisher Take-Two Interactive for failing to prevent the game files from leaking online.

"Months of takedowns, subpoenas, and wallet-tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving," Cyberleek wrote in a now-removed post on Reddit, insisting they were "fighting anti-consumerism" in the video games industry with their actions and using crypto funds to work on a new project. "There is no other way to move funds without names," Cyberleek added. "And this work requires no names."

As pointed out online, Cyberleek has already cashed out on their memecoin in August and again in October, raking in hundreds of thousands of US dollars. So far, it looks like modders are already making modest headway with the full Xbox build of GTA 6, as the Project Leonida Discord server (via Eurogamer) has footage of the game booting up on PC. That's as far as it gets (for now), as that start-up process is met with a black screen shortly afterward. Modders and homebrew enthusiasts are reportedly using Claude AI to reverse-engineer the game on that platform, and the group is confident that a playable build will be ready within a week.

Rockstar has yet to officially announce a PC port of GTA 6, but rumors suggest it could be out in early 2027. This would be a very short gap between console and PC releases for a Rockstar-developed game, as the studio's console-first projects usually spend many months in incubation before heading to PC. The threat of a homebrewed PC port, however, could pressure the developer to release GTA 6 on PC sooner rather than later.

Meanwhile, GTA 6 has done phenomenally well on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S since it launched last week. The game kicked off with 32.5 million copies sold on its first day , and just a few days later, that number reportedly rose to 44.9 million. PS5 sales have dominated, and Sony says GTA 6 was the biggest launch in PlayStation history.

content.v: 《GTA 6》在上市之后就掀起了猛烈的舆论风暴。
批评《GTA 6》的意见大体可以分为两个部分，其一是社会层面的，很多人对这款游戏的剧情不满，认为游戏的男主角杰森缺乏个性，女主角的性格又惹人生厌，由此引发出一系列批评。其二是游戏设计层面本身的，一些玩家认为这款游戏过于乏味，让玩家找不到“GTA的感觉”。
在社会层面上，游戏引发如此重大舆论风波的原因之一是GTA已经超越了单纯的游戏领域，而成为了一种“文化现象”。在《GTA 6》发售的那一个月里，几乎所有媒体、网红和论坛都在关注它，这也就导致了它成了真正意义上的流量密码。大量用户通过观看主播的游戏实况或游戏评论来建立对游戏的观感，而很多人对游戏的印象就是在这种传播过程中被扭曲和放大。
在初期，比较经典的传闻包括“男主和另一个男人睡在一起”（实际上是男主角和他的朋友玩游戏到深夜，两个人直接在男主家睡下）“男主不能在同性恋夜店开枪”（实际上游戏无法在所有夜店开枪）“男主角为了迎接女主出狱要做各种力工任务”（实际上这些任务加起来也不超过15分钟）等。
游戏发布之前，事先得到评测版本的媒体平均打出了99/100的分数。游戏发布之后，在Metacritic网站上开放玩家评分，玩家用打低分来表达自己的愤怒，游戏的分数最初仅为3.7/10分，之后一路走高。截至目前，分数达到了5.7/10分。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-24/8036b05423986e67.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
Metacritic网站并不验证评分者是否玩过这款游戏，只要用户拥有Metacritic账号，就可以给游戏打分。在PlayStation Store平台上，约有17万名玩家为游戏打出了4.84/5分的平均成绩。
这些源自猜测和愤怒的说法在游戏发售48小时后达到顶峰，但随着越来越多的人玩到游戏，以及游戏本身进程的发展，现在已经没有多少人再坚持这种说法了。触乐编辑查阅了中美两国论坛中的典型批评，发现中美玩家的愤怒点有一些细微的区别。简单来说，中国舆论场中的典型表达是“男主角为什么要如此卑微”，美国舆论场中的典型焦虑是“男主角还是一个有男子气概的人吗？”
这些区别和不同社会中的对立、冲突以及恐惧是息息相关的。有趣的是，玩家对自己在虚拟世界中是一个“传统意义上的坏蛋”并不排斥，但完全无法接受自己在虚拟世界中成为一个弱者。但这当然来源于我们所处的环境本身。我国的大背景是婚恋成本、性别对立以及普遍的社会焦虑，美国的大背景是文化战争、反觉醒运动以及……同样普遍的社会焦虑。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-24/1296b0547551270d.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

对于这个层面上的问题，坦率地说，我们并不想多谈，因为这并不是游戏所导致的问题，也并不是游戏能解决的问题。至于某些单纯基于审美（比如并不喜欢女主角肤色）的批评，也确实不是游戏的问题——有人认为，游戏可以给出不同的女主角选择，但只要玩了游戏就会发现，以游戏对于男女主角性格刻画，以及互动语言、动作的丰富程度，哪怕是Rockstar，恐怕也没有能力再做一个同等量级的女主角了。但不管怎么说吧，在游戏发售大概4天后，这种基于传言或者审美的批评声已经开始逐渐消失，现在的批评主要集中在游戏的设计层面上。
第一种批评意见在于游戏限制太多，无法带给玩家足够自由的感觉；第二种批评意见则认为游戏过于慢热，剧情铺垫太长；第三种批评意见则认为游戏玩法重复，接近“罐头游戏”。这三种批评意见大部分来源于真正玩过游戏的玩家，他们的感受一定程度上是真实的。
确实有很多玩家对《GTA 6》不满意！但这些不满意源自何处？从游戏行业从业者的角度来看，归根结底，我认为导致批评的原因一方面在于时代变了，另一方面在于这个游戏的规模太大了，大到了游荡在可控和不可控的边缘。

时代的变化让人百味杂陈。“GTA”系列的故事一直以来都是它区别于其他同类现代题材开放世界游戏的根本。开发组也一直在探索用开放世界叙事的边界，在3代——奠定了这一系列许多基础玩法的时代，这个游戏基本没有叙事，到了“罪恶都市”和“圣安德列斯”，游戏开始尝试塑造角色。到《GTA 4》的时候，当时的编剧丹·豪瑟刚从英国移民到纽约，过得很不开心，这种沮丧和烦恼也体现在游戏的主角身上，《GTA 4》的剧本被普遍认为是GTA系列中最有深度和最精彩的。
但问题在于，“GTA”系列其实是由两种玩法糅合在一起的，一个是可以为所欲为的开放世界，另一个是有明确主线、人物塑造和成长路线的主线剧情。在3代的时候，整个游戏世界相对抽象，故事也很简单，两者之间没有冲突，到了4代，玩家开始觉得主角的故事、人格和行事方式对自己在开放世界中的自由程度造成了影响。
基于这个原因，Rockstar在《GTA 5》中回归了诙谐喜剧的动作风格，并把主角拆成了3个人——一个是代表丹·豪瑟本人“成功后陷入中年危机”的麦克（这是我猜的但我很有把握），一个是相对代表传统GTA叙事路线的富兰克林，还有一个是完全代表混乱和本我的崔佛。
《GTA 5》非常成功，放在“GTA”整个系列中，《GTA 5》也是一个异类。主角们并不像系列里其他作品的主角那样从街头的小混混做起，在开场的多年前银行劫案之后，麦克以一个功成名就（但有中年危机）的姿态出现在豪宅中。这相较于惨兮兮的尼科或者CJ都好上太多了。
《GTA 6》则在一定程度上回归了传统的人物设定，两个出身于底层的人，相互扶持，一路前行。《GTA 6》的叙事手法是相对传统的好莱坞三幕剧格式，第一幕比重25%，用来交代人物、背景、欲望和核心矛盾；第二幕比重50%，核心是对抗，故事开始出现矛盾，不断提高行动代价。第三幕比重25%，核心是解决，角色做出关键选择，解决核心矛盾，完成人物弧光。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-24/3016b05472015ca2.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
然而《GTA 6》是一个全流程至少60小时的游戏。这也就意味着它的第一幕比重要达到至少10-15小时。具体在游戏中，第一章和第二章可以视为教学关，游戏到第三章才真正进入快车道——然而在当今的时代，在一个公众号文章超过3000字就要在开头标注“本文阅读时间约为20分钟”的时代，这种决定的下场是显而易见的。
但我并不会批评这种做法。如果在当今这个时代有一个游戏可以这么做，或者需要这么做，或者应该这么做，那可能就是《GTA 6》。我也始终相信好故事需要一定的篇幅承载，人也应该为了读到好东西而进行一些练习。

在早期，有人把《GTA 6》的剧情和《最后生还者 2》相提并论，不过最近这种说法明显变少了。我认为《最后生还者 2》的剧情确实处理得有些随意和过于激进，但《GTA 6》的整个剧情，至少目前我玩到的部分，我觉得是非常经典的，人物设定上就像标准情侣那样正常，结构上也非常正统——如果玩家不愿意付出一段时间来了解和接受一个相对复杂的人物背景，甚至不能接受一个平凡的、出身贫寒的、有成长创伤而并不是兵王的角色——那我也不觉得这是创作者的问题。
除了剧情，其他很多批评也来源于《GTA 6》的规模过于庞大，很多玩家无法忍受第一章和第二章的节奏，但对于一个这种体量的游戏而言，它有太多的系统需要玩家熟悉和掌握，《GTA 6》的体量已经和一个中等规模的MMORPG相提并论，而在网络游戏中，玩家通常需要至少几十小时来逐渐熟悉各种系统。
世界上当然有很多纯粹的快乐，但世界上同样有大量需要学习、掌握、熟练后才能感受到乐趣的快乐，就像我们需要在FPS游戏中练习枪法，需要在RPG中练级，需要在《魔兽世界》里学习一大堆东西那样。一个有深度的系统同样需要玩家付出时间和学习成本。
很多玩家抱怨《GTA 6》中犯罪准备过程过于繁琐，警察过于敏感，会记住玩家的衣着相貌等，难以消星，以至于失去了爽快的乐趣。在《GTA 6》之前，“GTA”系列的犯罪行动都可以被视为冲动犯罪，到某个点，进去就打，打完就跑。到了《GTA 6》，游戏的主线中开始出现有准备、有预谋的真实犯罪行动。一场犯罪需要经历踩点、计划、准备、执行和撤离等多个步骤。但这种行动过于复杂，所以只有设计好的几个有限任务。
《GTA 6》对此做出了非常大胆的创新，你可以把《GTA 6》里的很多抢劫任务看成是小副本，玩家同样需要进行周密的准备，实际上我常做的步骤是，先踩点，然后把车停到一个距离不远的偏僻场合，换一辆其他车，换专门的服装，去行动，然后带着战利品开车，换车，再去销赃。
这种行动风格可以再现那种“主角坐在车里，和迎面而来的闪着警笛的警察车队擦身而过”的场景，可以给人很大的快感和沉浸感。但问题在于，所有这一套行动同样需要学习成本。游戏的前一二章就是为了引导你学习这种相对周密的犯罪活动而设立的教学关。只不过这个教学关有大概10小时之长。
《GTA 6》确实也变得更加庞大复杂了。在6代之前，玩家在路边偷车是很简单的事情，玩家在经历过只能砸窗、可以用开锁条、可以用钥匙复制器、可以解GPS之后才能达到《GTA 5》的初始状态——这时候游戏已经进行了10个小时了。
然而玩家前期的压抑也带来了后期爽偷豪车的快感——这种处理是很标准的手段，只不过一方面，现在的时代不容忍等待，我们不接受延迟幸福，要立刻得到大结果！另一方面，就算你是GTA，这个等待时间确实也长了一点。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-24/5276b054709b697c.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
我觉得《GTA 6》的成功、惊人、无奈和瑕疵之处都来源于它的规模太庞大了——这是一个真正的庞然大物，韩国游戏媒体Inven Global对游戏片尾的制作人员名单进行了统计，去重后的制作人员总数是10570人——10000人做一个游戏，这是什么概念！我有时候甚至觉得游戏中的很多设计已经超越了为功能而开发，而进入到了类似“我们还有一个500人的组闲着，我们给他们下个工单吧！”的状态。
《GTA 6》的很多设计其实是当前状态下的最优解。如果你也要投入10000人，用超过6年、超过10亿美元的投资去做一个游戏，那么你的选择范围也必然被极度缩窄。你必须找到一个足够复杂、足够有深度的玩法，用一个足够复杂、足够有空间的故事去讲述它。就好像你要做院线大片，可选的方向也只有有限的那几种一样。对于《GTA 6》而言，走向现实主义题材，更严肃、更复杂、更深刻、是一种选择，也是一种必然。

《GTA 6》的整体规模并不亚于任何一个MMORPG，它拥有的每一项游戏模块——车辆、战斗、故事、换装、各种迷你游戏，单拿出来都足够以一个单独游戏的身份发售，卖个39.99美元。而现在它要做的事把所有这些东西捏成一个世界——这就让整个游戏不同模块之间的耦合难度呈几何级数上升。我对这个游戏规模的敬畏已经达到了游戏就算出BUG我也完全理解的程度——它也确实时不时地出点小BUG，实际上我觉得这个游戏能够成功做出来就已经是神迹了。
曾几何时，“GTA”系列是一个生猛、粗粝和充满着年轻人混不吝风格的游戏。然而就像我们一样，它也终于长大了，它从一个没什么可失去的愤怒的青年变成了一个需要顾忌方方面面的成功人士。我相信《GTA 6》的开发者已经努力做到了最好，在游戏中，我没有感到当年如《最后生还者 2》那种充斥在游戏中的疲惫和厌倦（我真的在《最后生还者 2》中感觉到开发者深深的疲惫）。但我也确实感觉到了一些社会中坚力量的责任心……
另外，我个人对《GTA 6》主要的批评——其实更多的可能是一点儿失望，就是它只是把旧有的基础做得庞大、精美和复杂无比，为了这一点他们一定解决了许多人难以想象的问题，比如协调1000万个NPC的生活之类的。这很厉害，但确实没有开辟某些新的世界，但我觉得可能也没人能做到这一点，所以我只能说失望而不是批评。
此外，我能明显感觉到《GTA 6》把很多系统留待Online版开放，比如房屋系统、汽车、船只购买系统之类。当然，这也没什么不对，毕竟我们在讨论一个可能占据50%以上收入，寿命必然超过10年的在线模式。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-24/6086b0546ec15d31.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
话说回来，我们该从对《GTA 6》的批评中学到什么吗？我觉得其实不需要。因为这些批评很大程度都是一款优秀作品在被接受时所经历的过程。一方面，我们之前也曾经报道过很多次，当今时代，往往是占据玩家人数1%的人发出了100%的声音，实际上我完全相信随着时间推移，《GTA 6》的好评度会持续上升。另一方面，当然也会有很多人不喜欢它、不适应它，这些人没有任何问题，但一个游戏也可以选择它的用户。
我的很多朋友，包括我，在玩《GTA 6》的时候都会陷入一种莫名的伤感之中，不知道为什么，我经常觉得我在目睹某一个时代的终结。我感觉在当前的游戏形态（即用平面显示屏和手柄玩游戏）下，《GTA 6》已经是终极形态了。在之后很难想象还有游戏能够用这样大的规模和投入营造这样的世界了。也因为这样，我会有一种我看到了巅峰时刻，之后就是下坡路的感觉。

而它遭遇的这些批评——虽然我并不能同意其中很多批评，但我完全承认它们的感受是真实的——则在一定程度上展现出我们已经不一定需要这些故事了。但真的是这样吗？我其实一直还希望看到一种可能性，就是在玩家真正接触到这个游戏之后，仍然会被更有深度的故事和系统打动。就像当年全盛时期的暴雪用《魔兽世界》培养了全中国的主流玩家接受3D网游，接受了没有主动寻路和不能自动打怪那样。如果在现在这个时代有什么游戏可以一定程度地培养玩家慢下来的能力，那么或许就是《GTA 6》了。
也许它能成功——我目前至少比较乐观，无论从评分，还是从社交网络的风评，它都在逐渐转向好评。当然，也可能它会失败，但我觉得它至少试过了。《GTA 6》试图缓缓地向我们讲述一个故事，并在这个故事中反映整个美国，就像斯科塞斯拍摄《爱尔兰人》或者《纽约黑帮》那样。它就像是那种豪华邮轮，庞大、奢华，昂贵，用几个月的时间缓缓地跨越海洋。然而现在的问题是，或许航空时代来临了。

items.title: GTA6惨遭移植PC 目前帧数也仅30帧！加载世界50秒
items.summary: 据俄媒PlayGround.ru报道，多个民间团队正尝试把主机独占的《GTA6》非官方搬到PC上，其中Marvisak开发的名为VIctory项目自称已能进…

content.v: 据俄媒PlayGround.ru报道，多个民间团队正尝试把主机独占的《GTA6》非官方搬到PC上，其中Marvisak开发的名为VIctory项目自称已能进入主菜单，帧率约30帧。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/24/cas_auto/small_0_9492011.jpg
报道称，VIctory已能启动开场画面、主菜单、档案与存档系统，开场视频和音效也能播放，加载游戏世界约需50秒，并可进入首个任务的开场场景，但完整的世界画面尚未呈现。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/24/cas_auto/small_0_9492018.jpg
该媒体还提到，29个移植与模拟项目中已有5个进入启动阶段，VIctory以67%的进度指标领先，前三名平均为59%， 这些百分比只反映技术阶段完成度，不代表完整PC移植版已就绪。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/24/cas_auto/small_0_9492024.jpg
对玩家来说，这类进展之所以受关注，是因为官方PC版长期没有明确消息，民间实验成了观察技术可能性的窗口。不过报道本身也强调，目前谈完整可玩性为时过早，图形、性能和稳定性问题仍待解决。
《GTA6》全收集地图上线 ，看它开局就能赚两万多，所有收集品、高跟鞋俱乐部、隐藏彩蛋位置都在这！
https://imgs.gamersky.com/upimg/new_preview/2026/11/20/origin_202611200954402940.jpg
欢迎加入《GTA》交流群： 1130479237

items.title: 曝160万中国PS5玩家购买了《GTA6》！全球第五

content.v: 根据@alineaanalytics的估算，截至周末，《GTA6》PS5版全球销量已超过3370万份，其中销量最高的国家和地区基本符合预期。
具体来看：
美国以1110万份位居第一，占PS5版总销量的32.8%
法国300万份（9.0%），排名第二
英国销量为250万份（7.3%），排名第三
德国为170万份（5.1%），排名第四
中国则以160万份（4.7%），排名第五
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795490366_688891.jpg
这一结果并不令人意外。《GTA》系列本质上是一个以西方市场为主导的现象级IP，《GTA6》也是一款具有浓厚西方文化背景的游戏。区域数据表明，61%的玩家来自北美和西欧，而整个亚洲地区的玩家占比仅略高于16%。
值得一提的是，中国市场占比达到了4.7%。考虑到目前大部分中国玩家都是通过灰色渠道购买游戏（主要是通过香港PS商店绕行购买），这一成绩仍然值得关注。可以预见，等到《GTA6》Steam版推出后（预计在明年某个时候），中国玩家群体的规模还将进一步扩大。
至于《GTA6》未来能否在中国获得官方游戏版号，作者认为基本没有可能。不过，这似乎也不会对游戏在中国市场的表现造成太大影响。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795490632_634492_jpg_r.jpg
网友评价：
如果GTA6登陆pc的话，中国的销量很快就会冲上第二甚至第一
中国已经开始赶上德国这样的成熟市场，这一事实真是令人震惊，我们不要忘记，这是一个不久前还禁止游戏机的国家，而且PC游戏占据了绝对主导地位。
我认为中国不会在PC上展示全部实力。中国人通常不喜欢那种西方的极左宣传内容。而且PC玩家现在已经被警告了，这是一款中等品质的游戏，画面确实很不错
在我看来，印度也应该名列前茅。这个国家确实有真正的热潮。
法国300万销量太疯狂了，半数国民貌似都买了

items.title: 超级厄尔尼诺发威 狂风暴雪袭击日本：积雪达53厘米
items.summary: 在超级厄尔尼诺现象叠加冬季炸弹气旋的共同作用下，日本北部、东部迎来今冬首轮大范围强暴雪天气，狂风伴大雪侵袭北海道、福岛等地…

content.v: 11月24日消息，在超级厄尔尼诺现象叠加冬季炸弹气旋（爆发性气旋）的共同作用下，日本北部、东部迎来今冬首轮大范围强暴雪天气，狂风伴大雪侵袭北海道、福岛、石川县等地，部分区域风雪威力接近台风。
气象监测数据显示，北海道倶知安町24小时新增积雪 32 厘米，深川市新增积雪28厘米；福岛部分地区积雪深度达53厘米。受积雪封堵道路影响，当地约1400名居民一度交通受阻，与外界失联。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611241851485297.jpg
本轮天气过程中，大风破坏力突出。石川县羽咋市观测到33.8 米/秒的瞬时阵风，达12级；金泽市阵风29.1米/秒，属于台风级风力。强风导致工地脚手架坍塌、路灯杆折断，路面结冰打滑，多起交通事故接连发生。
恶劣天气冲击当地交通与电力系统。日本东北部分路段列车出现脱轨险情，多条铁路紧急停运；多个乡镇大范围停电，抢修人员冒雪连夜除雪、抢修线路，截至23日，部分区域交通、供电仍未恢复正常。
当地政府持续发布大雪、强风预警，呼吁民众非必要不外出，提醒山区居民防范积雪垮塌、雪崩风险。
世界气象组织预警，本轮超级厄尔尼诺强度有刷新纪录的可能，预计12月抵达峰值。异常大气环流将持续扰动东亚冬季天气，极端冷暖波动、强降水和暴雪事件风险走高。
气象专家表示，厄尔尼诺会打乱冬季原有气候规律，并非简单对应“多雪”或“少雪”；当其与炸弹气旋这类强天气系统配合时，极易诱发极端暴雪，相关区域需做好防范。

items.title: 《GTA6》互动地图基本完成 诚邀您继续参与建设！

content.v: 地图上的随机事件点位，已经被各位老哥标到 100 个以上了。
《GTA6》互动地图上线一周多，随机事件这一栏从稀稀拉拉变成了能翻着用的列表。100 多个点位，常见的刷新区域基本都覆盖到了。
这些点位全是玩家自己撞见、自己标的。有人在街头刚好撞见，回头就打开地图把坐标补上；也有人顺手把触发条件、要不要带特定载具一起写清楚。所谓少玩 5 块钱的遗憾，就是这么一点一点补回来的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/24/origin_8204994_9492102.jpg
前往地图看看： 《GTA6》全收集互动地图
【如何使用地图】
以前碰上随机事件全凭运气，现在打开地图按分类筛一下，附近有没有、触发条件是啥，心里直接门清。再也不用纠结了！
除了随机事件以外，隐藏彩蛋、商店差事攻略也一直有人在标。游戏大地图中没有的点，比如：收藏卡、达布隆硬币、杂志、冥想点、AI爽窥、改款武器、出众载具。这些在游民地图上也都有标记！
找不到东西的时候，先按分类筛，再放大区域，比在网站查攻略快得多，也不用担心翻到一半被剧透。
【诚邀您分享点位】
罪城还大得很，随机事件的刷新点远不止这些，地图上没标到的角落还多，正等你去踩。撞见地图上没有的，直接标上去。
现有点位信息不全、坐标偏了，点开详情改一下也算。门槛不高，活动期内累计 3 个有效点位就算参与。
【点位编辑方法】
完整教程和规则都在活动帖里： 罪城导游招募中，标点位赢好礼 。
【活动持续到12月10日】
现在上车还来得及。按贡献排名，前 17 名有京东卡（第 1—3 名 100 元，第 4—17 名 50 元），前 5 名另送猎户座 3C 手柄一支。金币全员可拿，满 3 个有效点位先送 500，之后每个有效点位再加 50，进前 20 名再送 1000。
想要知道贡献了多少？随时点此查榜： 《GTA6》地图贡献榜 。
【加群交流】
想认领品类缺口、反馈地图问题，进地图编辑群： 563526950 （ 点此加群 ）。
只是想聊剧情、找人组队，进玩家讨论群： 1130479237 （ 点此加群 ）。

content.v: 11月23日，漫威影业在发布《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》终极预告的同时，还公开了一张毁灭博士全新角色海报。海报采用了极具压迫感的近景构图，只展示了毁灭博士戴着金属面具的半张脸，一只眼睛从面具缝隙中露出。

content.v: ANY.TECH旗下独立游戏发行部门LUMISLE GAMES今日正式面向全球独立游戏开发者开放发行合作。无论项目尚在原型阶段、处于抢先体验，还是已临近发售，开发团队均可提交作品。LUMISLE GAMES将提供覆盖研发资金、本地化、宣传推广到全平台发行的一站式支持，帮助小团队把创作的闪光，变成被更多玩家看见的光。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795515846_828641.png
一、我们为什么出发
独立游戏最动人的创意，往往诞生于只有几个人甚至一个人的小团队。然而资金缺口、语言壁垒、平台门槛与宣发经验的不足，让许多作品在被玩家看见之前就悄然沉寂。LUMISLE GAMES相信，好的创意不该被资源规模所埋没。我们希望成为小团队身后那座亮着灯的小岛——让开发者专注创作，其余的事，交给我们。
二、四大核心支持
1. 研发资金支持
— 提供项目制研发资金与里程碑式付款，帮助覆盖开发、外包美术、音频等成本，缓解团队的现金流压力。
— 合作条款清晰透明，不要求团队让渡创作自主权，IP所有权归属以双方协议约定为准。
— 协助对接外部测试、技术中间件及行业资源，降低开发过程中的不确定性。
2. 本地化支持
— 覆盖英语、日语、韩语、欧洲主要语种及东南亚语种的专业文本本地化。
— 提供配音、字幕与商店素材本地化，并针对各地文化习惯进行表达适配。
— 由母语审校与本地化QA共同把关，避免机翻痕迹与文化误读。
3. 宣传推广支持
— 负责Steam等平台商店页策划、视觉优化、愿望清单运营与发售节奏管理。
— 运营官方社媒矩阵，统筹KOL与媒体投放、线上直播试玩及线下展会亮相。
— 协同策划制作宣传片、Key Art等营销物料，让作品在海量信息中被准确记住。
4. 全平台发行支持
— 覆盖PC(Steam等)、PlayStation、Xbox、Nintendo Switch及移动端的发行与移植对接。
— 处理平台关系、评级送审、合规咨询、定价策略与区域定价。
— 提供销售数据看板、用户反馈分析与发售后的持续运营支持。
三、合作流程
— 提交：通过合作邮箱提交Pitch，包含团队介绍、Demo或视频、开发计划、预算与合作需求。
— 评估：发行团队在约定时间内完成试玩评估，并给出明确反馈。
— 方案：双方确认合作范围、资金与发行方案，签署正式协议。
— 同行：组建专属发行小组，从开发到发售再到长期运营全程陪跑。
四、我们期待这样的你
— 不限团队规模与所在地区，仅有一人的工作室同样欢迎。
— 项目可以是原型、垂直切片、抢先体验或待发售阶段。
— 拥有清晰的创作表达，以及把项目坚持完成的意愿。
— 目前我们已与《雾镇来信》《云端打捞局》等开发团队达成合作。
每一束光，都值得被拾起。LUMISLE GAMES，愿做独立创作者身后那座不灭的灯塔。

content.v: 靠打游戏拿到职业赛事成绩，年仅21岁的电竞选手何炅昊，近一年的各类收入总和已经超过200万元，而仅仅在两年前，他还是一名刚考入普通本科院校的在校大学生。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795498140_865538_jpg_r.jpg
11月13日至15日，云顶之弈S18自然之力全球总决赛决赛在西安曲江电竞中心正式举办，这一届赛事的决赛史无前例打满了八局。
最终来自中国CN赛区的选手直接包揽了冠亚军，其中拿下亚军的选手何炅昊，ID为TLG·糕手雕妹，一路鏖战到了最后一局的最后时刻才分出胜负。
赛后接受媒体采访时何炅昊坦言，自己当天的发挥已经达到赛前的预期状态，但差一步没能拿到最高领奖台，心底还是留了不小的遗憾，接下来会好好复盘调整状态，希望下次国际赛场能打出更好的成绩。
何炅昊出生于2005年，2023年顺利考入大庆师范学院数学专业。
大一学年读完之后，他已经靠各类民间赛事奖金、游戏代练、陪玩等收入，完全覆盖了自己的学费和日常开销，也用实打实的成绩说服了父母，同意自己休学一年尝试冲击职业电竞赛道。
在何炅昊自己看来，眼下拿到的全球亚军成绩，只是职业道路上的阶段性收获而已。
职业电竞行业的竞争烈度远超外界想象，对选手的游戏天赋、临场心态、日常自律性还有持续学习调整的能力都有极高要求，能站上全球顶级赛场拿到靠前名次，本来就是极小概率的事件。
他特别提醒所有年轻网友，绝对不建议脑子一热就贸然效仿自己休学打职业的选择，一定要先在相关赛事里拿到足够有说服力的稳定成绩，再去仔细做长远的职业规划，不要把小概率的成功当成唾手可得的常态。
