items.title: 《赛博朋克2》创意总监称《GTA6》带来开发压力 取消项目只是玩笑
items.summary: 《赛博朋克2》创意总监Igor Sarzynski表示，《GTA6》令他感受到开放世界游戏开发者的压力。他随后拿“《赛博朋克2》取消了”开玩笑，但这并非项目取消的正式消息。Sarzynski在Bluesky上将这种感受称

others.title: 《赛博朋克 2》创意总监表示，他患有“GTA 6 引发的开放世界游戏开发抑郁症”，并开玩笑说“《赛博朋克 2》被取消”

content.v: It's been a big week for videogames—or rather, videogame. Grand Theft Auto 6 is enjoying what may very well be the single greatest media launch in history, securing over $3.7 billion in launch sales. But as Rockstar enjoys its acclaim, other developers—like Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski—are professing some anxiety about releasing their own games in a post-GTA 6 world.

"GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real. Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle," Sarzynski said on Bluesky over the weekend, joking that "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LCrpZWkihxuCXsPPU9FZa3-1920-80.png
That news came as a surprise to Cyberpunk 2 lead writer Anna Megill, who replied with a baffled "But wait—"

Sarzynski was, of course, just goofing. But I'm sympathetic to any game dev who might be feeling an amount of apprehension about being measured against GTA 6's success, particularly when there's a genre overlap.

In Cyberpunk 2's case, however, CD Projekt is very much in its own lane: Cyberpunk is a different thematic setting, with entirely different systems and design goals. I'd hope that any reasonable person would think comparing the two is like comparing apples and oranges—particularly when the oranges reportedly had a production budget upwards of $1 billion .

In a follow-up post , Sarzynski acknowledged that each project is doing its own thing, while noting that GTA 6's example will benefit other game developers by serving as a source of creative inspiration.

"Seriously though, I think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor," he said. "GTA is impressive in a way all great art is: It expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4UAoyCLM246CLeZy7wBXb-1920-80.jpg

content.v: Lilvo公布了超小型双屏模拟掌机DS Micro的原型机。设备闭合后尺寸为3.35×1.81×0.71英寸，高度接近银行卡，宽度与银行卡长度相仿，目标是将双屏掌机压缩至接近钥匙扣大小。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795469787_299784_jpg_r.jpg
DS Micro配备两块256×192分辨率屏幕，下屏支持触控。机身带有3.5毫米接口和MicroSD扩展，运行Lilvo自有的Linux系统，并配有风格化前端及文件管理器。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795469788_906042.jpg
开发者表示，该项目优先考虑体积和续航，并不追求原始性能。早期测试中，2D Nintendo DS游戏运行情况较好；3D作品则会出现跳帧，同时带来更高耗电。因此，这款设备目前还不是适用于所有Nintendo DS游戏的成熟模拟方案。
Lilvo现阶段只有一台可工作的原型机，价格、预售时间和上市日期均未公布。开发者计划继续完善项目，未来推动量产并提供多种彩色外壳；屏幕可读性、3D性能、电池表现及量产可行性仍有待后续实机验证。

items.title: 每个 GTA 6 结局以及如何获得它们
items.summary: All the endings (and a couple variations) for GTA 6 we've seen so far.

content.v: Obviously, massive spoilers follow for GTA 6 endings!

There are multiple endings to GTA 6 , and while we haven't experienced them all personally here at PC Gamer, the gaming community has been sharing them around for anyone curious about what they may have missed.

The ending you get depends on the choices you make during the final GTA 6 story mission , but also depends on how you handled Jason and Lucia's romance and criminal profiles throughout the game, so seeing every version of the ending would mean not just playing the ending multiple times, but having different playthroughs of the game altogether.

There are a couple of endings that I don't consider "different" from each other but do have some differences leading up to them, which I'll explain below. There may also be additional endings we haven't seen yet, so we may update this guide in the future.
GTA 6 endings on the bridge

In the bridge endings, Jason and Lucia have defeated Mendez and his squad and gotten the hard drive back from Georgio's penthouse and escaped. They drive to Cal's place in Key Lento, but discover he has been compromised. They drive to the bridge, but the cops have set up a roadblock and have the couple trapped. Lucia wants to keep going, but Jason suggests they jump off the bridge and swim for it.
A choice comes up on the screen: "Swim For it" or "No Surrender."
Ending 1: No Surrender

Jason and Lucia try to run the roadblock and are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, we see that their son Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children.
How to get this ending:
Ending 2: No Surrender + $2 million

Jason and Lucia are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, their lawyer, Abe, brings the money to Lucia's aunt. Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children in a much bigger house than the other No Surrender ending.
How to get this ending:
Ending 3: Swim for it
Choosing "Swim for it" presents an additional choice. When Jason gets out of the car, Lucia can choose to "Exit" the car with him, or change her mind by not choosing it.

Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. They both exit the car without holding guns. Lucia jumps, but Jason doesn't jump and is arrested. Lucia signs a deal for immunity while Jason goes to prison. Lucia gets a job in a diner. Lucia takes Tomas to meet Jason in prison, but he can only see his son through a glass divider.
How to get this ending:
Ending 4: Swim for it + Don't Exit

Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. Jason exits the car with a gun, but Lucia changes her mind and stays in the car. The police open fire and Jason and Lucia are both shot to death. Tomas lives with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children.
How to get this ending:
GTA 6's Happiest Ending
Ending 5: Swim for it + Exit + $2 million (Happiest Ending)

Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it, Jason doesn't jump and is arrested. Two years later, Lucia uses the savings account to get Jason freed from prison. Lucia goes to the prison to pick up Jason. Jason meets Tomas and holds his hand.
How to get this ending:
GTA 6 endings at the tower

If you don't have a strong relationship between Jason and Lucia, there is a different ending location: the base of Georgio's tower. In these endings, the couple never makes it to the bridge. You can also choose to break up the couple, either as Jason or as Lucia, as you begin the mission Protective Custody.
Ending 6: Stay down

After the tower fight with Georgio's men, police confront the couple at the base of the tower. The police open fire and Jason pushes Lucia down. Jason is shot. Lucia has a choice to "Stay down" or "Defend Jason". She stays down and watches Jason die. Lucia is arrested, signs a deal, and visits Tomas at her aunt's house. Lucia then leaves Tomas with her aunt, takes out a gun, and continues her life of crime by preparing to rob a diner.
How to get this ending:
Ending 7: Defend Jason

After the tower fight with Georgio's men, police confront them at the base of the tower. The police open fire and Jason pushes Lucia down. Jason is shot. Lucia chooses "Defend Jason" and fights the cops. They die together.
How to get this ending:
Ending 8: Jason escapes

On the way down to ground level at the tower, Jason decides to run. Lucia is arrested and signs the deal, then lives with her aunt and Tomas while working in a diner. One night there's a knock on the door and she finds a bag of cash on the porch. We see Jason driving away with... Rocco the drug-sniffing dog from earlier in the game. Sure, that might as well happen.
How to get this ending (sourced by GamingwithTZ on YouTube ):
GTA 6's Darkest Ending
Ending 9: Make a deal (Darkest Ending)

Jason and Lucia make a deal with Mendez after defeating him. Once they have the hard drive, they're surrounded by cops at the bottom of the tower. Mendez arrives and takes them away in his car, then drives them to the swamp. Later in the credits, we see two skulls in the swamp, side-by-side, with a bullet hole in each.
How to get this ending:

Note : You may need a specific criminal profile for this ending. I tried to take the deal (as Lucia) in one of my ending playthroughs, but Jason shot Mendez anyway. I had both Jason and Lucia at "Professional" level criminal profiles. This ending was not available to me. Speculation, but this ending may only be available if you don't have "Professional" as your criminal profiles.
More Endings?

There are potentially (and almost certainly) more endings to GTA 6. There are still a few combinations of all the different variables, including your romance level, criminal profile level, amount of money saved, and the choices you make during the final mission, that we haven't seen yet.
We'll update this guide if the community finds more endings.

items.title: 2026 年 Steam 大奖让过去 10 年的 GOTY 获奖者展开全面争夺霸主之战
items.summary: It's the 10th anniversary of the Steam Awards and that means it's time for something new.

content.v: The festive month of December is rapidly bearing down on us and you know what that means: It's time for another round of the Steam Awards, the annual exercise in which we hand out awards to our favorite games on Steam, hence the name. First, though, comes the nomination process , which kicked off today and will run until November 30.

This year's event is a little different from those of years past, because 2026 is the 10th anniversary of the Steam Awards. To mark the big birthday, Valve has added a few new categories inspired by previous years:

For even bigger excitement, there's also a new "Hall of Fame" category that pits the Game of the Year winners from the previous decade against one another in a final fight for supremacy. The contenders are:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZPNSbATd974mHu9xfaVf5k-1920-80.png

Apart from the Hall of Fame category, which is locked to those 10 games, Steam Award nominations are wide open: For each category, Steam will provide you with a list of games you've played as well as "popular and recommended games" you haven't, but you can throw in whatever game you want in whatever category you like, as long as it was released in 2026.
Serious Sam Shatterverse for "Outstanding Story-Rich Game Award?" Yes you can .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wrceWJxKmFBT7g5iQsAcEj-1920-80.png
Not that I recommend you actually do , to be clear.

As always, nominating games will not only put your support behind your favorite games of the year, it will also earn you coveted Steam badges. Nominations will close on November 30—the nominees will be revealed, and voting will begin, with the start of the Steam Winter Sale on December 17.

items.title: GTA 6 的这个故障（几乎）毁掉了游戏最具标志性的场景
items.summary: Note: This story will discuss a pivotal mission in Chapter 2 of Grand Theft Auto 6. A powerful sequence in Gra

content.v: Note: This story will discuss a pivotal mission in Chapter 2 of Grand Theft Auto 6.
A powerful sequence in Grand Theft Auto 6 is quickly becoming a favorite among the game's many players, but a technical mishap made my experience of this scene very different--hilariously different.

Chapter 2 of GTA 6 begins with Jason and Lucia in a rough spot, with the former still recovering from major injuries sustained at the end of Chapter 1 , and the latter having to care for him. It isn't until the mission "Breakfast Run" that Jason is back on his feet, and the Bonnie-and-Clyde-like duo mark his recovery with a crime spree.

Set to "Money or Nothing" by Dire Straits , Lucia and Jason rob a diner, not dissimilar to a scene from Pulp Fiction, and a playable montage shows the pair robbing convenience shops, a clothing store, and other establishments. The image of Jason and Lucia busting open double doors, guns in hand, is probably the most iconic image of GTA 6, a statement of intent that defines the game's story going forward.

But somehow, I had gotten a slightly different version of this montage. When I returned to the motel as Lucia, I sprinted toward the door , only for the game to place me back outside the room. The game told me to "Go to Hank's Waffles" with no additional context, and I walked back into the motel to find Jason, not only up and about, but only sporting his underwear, bandages, and a buzz cut.

I suspected that there was a cutscene that I missed showing Jason fully recovered, so I decided to carry out the mission. The problem was that Jason wouldn't put any clothes on. I drove to the diner as the game instructed me to, and the entire mission, Dire Straits and all, resumed with a mostly naked Jason.

It was impossible not to cackle at the sheer absurdity of the situation, watching Jason terrorize locals and presumably solidifying a new legacy as the Leonida underwear robber. At one point, the camera cut to Jason's bare foot slamming a gas pedal, and I was left breathless from laughter. Eventually, the game decided to put clothes back on Jason, but I had to visit a salon to grow his hair back.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/1a209704c1f82-master_playlist_still.jpg?w=636

Though GTA 6 features nudity in various degrees, you cannot dress Jason and Lucia in their underwear outside of their home. That sprint through the motel room door must have bypassed some sort of clothing check and allowed Jason to freely show skin outside of the motel. I've seen players online talk about an "underwear glitch," and I found one Reddit comment saying that they also had a nearly naked Jason run about in "Breakfast Run," so I appear to be an edge case in experiencing this specific glitch.

I can't say that this bug "ruined" one of GTA 6's best missions for me, as I still found myself thoroughly entertained--just not in the way Rockstar Games wanted. Having Jason in his undies while still concealing his identity with a hat and bandana felt like something out of a Saints Row game rather than the fairly serious story GTA 6 was building up to that point.

Despite the intense work and detail put into GTA 6, it certainly isn't free of silly glitches and bugs such as this. Luckily, many of them are more amusing than hampering, and Rockstar Games is already putting out post-launch patches for the title. If anything, I'm just bummed that I can't spend the rest of the game as Underwear Jason.

content.v: 消息称，代号“Helix”的下一代Xbox早期曾按完整游戏个人电脑规划，可运行现有Xbox主机游戏，并支持Windows桌面与Steam。取消多人联机付费墙的成本也曾被纳入方案，但这些功能能否保留至今尚无法确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795468706_832152_jpg_r.jpg
按照原始构想，设备启动后会进入以手柄操作为主的Xbox全屏界面，用户也可退出至Windows桌面并自行安装软件，Steam包含在可安装范围内。消息人士称，哥谭赛车计划3当时认为，开放式个人电脑若仍要求用户为联网对战额外付费，产品定位将难以自洽。
这套设计形成于Phil Spencer与Sarah Bond领导Xbox期间。两人离任后，新管理层对Helix的公开描述更接近一款“以主机为先、具备游玩个人电脑游戏能力”的设备，因此完整Steam支持和免费多人联机是否仍在当前计划中并不明确。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794532871_879392_jpg_r.jpg
开放平台还可能削弱依靠后续收入补贴硬件的模式，使收入更多依赖设备售价，而零部件价格上涨会进一步增加成本。哥谭赛车计划3内部分析据称显示，不少Xbox Ally用户拥有选择时会优先使用Steam，这可能与重新吸引用户进入Xbox生态的方向冲突。目前仅能确认上述功能属于早期构想，Helix的最终形态、售价、商店开放程度和联机收费安排均未正式公布。

content.v: Alinea Analytics分析师Rhys Elliott估算，《GTA6》当前销量已达4490万份，距离5000万份里程碑不远。这一数字属于第三方阶段性估算，尚未得到Rockstar或Take-Two确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261124/1795468623_117448_jpg_r.jpg
按照Elliott给出的平台拆分数据，PlayStation 5版本约售出3370万份，Xbox平台约售出1120万份。Rockstar与母公司Take-Two此前披露，游戏预购量为3200万份；若第三方估算准确，作品自11月19日推出后的四天内又售出约1200万份。
消息还称，《GTA6》首日收入接近40亿美元，并创下娱乐产品发行纪录。不过，4490万份销量、各平台占比及首日收入均未由发行商正式公布。
作为参照，《巫师3：狂猎》和《上古卷轴5：天际》的累计销量约为6500万份。如果《GTA6》很快突破5000万份，其达到这一规模所用的时间将十分突出，但距离《给他爱5》累计2.35亿份的成绩仍有很大差距。
《GTA6》目前尚未登陆PC。后续PC版本及潜在在线模式可能进一步扩大受众，但现阶段尚无得到官方确认的发行安排。

items.title: 2023 年住院的侠盗猎车手 6 黑客已获假释，并警告不得再犯
items.summary: Following his guilty plea, Arion Kurtaj was given a seven-year sentence but released "on license" with a warni

content.v: A BBC report says Arion Kurtaj, the Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker who was given an indefinite sentence in hospital in 2023 because he kept hacking into things or expressing intent to, has been released with a stern warning not to do it again.

Kurtaj was sentenced to seven years in prison, according to the report, but was released on license—similar to parole in North America—the same day, with his hospital stay and time in prison while awaiting retrial credited as time served. He was given a five-year "Serious Crime Prevention Order" restricting his allowable online activity, including bans on using Telegram and Discord.

"Kurtaj knew what he was doing when he carried out these crimes and has finally admitted his involvement," Detective Inspector Mike O'Sullivan of the City of London Police said following Kurtaj's sentencing and release. "We hope this case serves as a lesson that these types of acts will not be tolerated.

"Although cyber crime is borderless, we will seek to utilise the co-operation of partner agencies and international law enforcement to ensure that offenders are brought to justice no matter where they offend from." Kurtaj carried out hacks against multiple companies when he was 16 and 17 years old, including Microsoft , Samsung , Nvidia and UK telecom company BT&EE, and stole millions in cryptocurrency from individuals.

But it was his hack of Rockstar and leak of GTA 6 materials more than a year before it was formally revealed, that earned him notoriety, not least because of how it was carried out: While under police protection in a Travelodge hotel room , using an Amazon Fire Stick and a mobile phone.

A psychiatric assessment determined that Kurtaj had "acute autism," and that he "continued to express the intent to return to cybercrime as soon as possible" while he was in custody. That led to his hospital sentence , but earlier this year he was found fit to stand trial and subsequently pleaded guilty to all charges .

That struck me as odd—why plead guilty to crimes carried out at a time when your mental state was such that a court decided you required multiple years of institutionalization?—but this may be the answer: Kurtaj, now 21, is a free man. The judge on the case told Kurtaj he is "a very talented young man," but also warned him: "Don't let this happen again."

items.title: PS5 游戏黑色星期五特卖 售价 15 美元
items.titleEn: PS5 Games on Sale for $15 for Black Friday

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/untitled-design-1795466994088.png
在过去（几​​年前），你必须等到黑色星期五的实际一天，杀手级交易才会出现。那些日子已经正式过去了。今天，在黑色星期五正式开始前的周一，沃尔玛启动了“黑色星期五活动 2”，推出了一些绝对杀手级的优惠，亚马逊的价格与其中大部分优惠相当。折扣包括一系列 PS5 游戏仅售 15 美元。这些游戏都很棒而且不是那么老。因此，抓住你想要的东西，因为你不太可能很快找到更便宜的东西。
PS5 游戏特价 15 美元
我们在谈论什么游戏？首先，《四海兄弟：旧国》是去年推出的一款出色的单人游戏，我们的评论家称其“有效回归了原版《四海兄弟》和《四海兄弟 II》的线性且紧密故事驱动的格式。”
然后是《刺客信条：暗影》，育碧的长期运行系列终于来到了日本。我们在评论中给了它 8/10 的评分，并表示：“通过锐化现有系统的优势，《刺客信条：暗影》创造了过去十年磨练的开放世界风格的最佳版本之一。”

items.title: 美国银行股票分析师表示，《GTA 6 Online》的规模可能会超过《堡垒之夜》
items.summary: Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two are riding high currently from the success of Grand Theft Auto 6 wi

content.v: Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two are riding high currently from the success of Grand Theft Auto 6 with a reported 45 million copies sold and $4 billion in revenue already , but this could just the beginning of how much money GTA 6 could bring in. According to Bank of America stock analyst Omar Dessouky, the initial success of GTA 6 reinforces the company's belief that the game has a massive reach, and with that comes the possibility of monetizing the players even more when the next evolution of GTA Online is released.

In fact, SeekingAlpha reported that Dessouky said he is so bullish that he believes GTA Online alone "can become a multibillion-dollar franchise, potentially larger than Fortnite." He said Fortnite generates as much as $5 billion in annual revenue, and GTA Online could be bigger in the fullness of time.
The stock analyst went on to raise his price target on Take-Two's stock to $350. That would represent a significant upside, considering Take-Two currently trades at around $210/share.
Take-Two's stock got hammered in 2026 and never fully recovered . The company's shares are down 16% so far in 2026 and down 12% over the past year.

Investing is a long-term game, though. Zooming out, Take-Two has crushed it since GTA 5 released. If you bought $10,000 worth of Take-Two stock on the day GTA 5 came out in 2013, and never sold, you'd have more than $120,000 today .
As for the next iteration of GTA Online, Rockstar has not said a word about what to expect or if such a mode is even coming. GTA 6, after all, is marketed as a strictly single-player game.

That being said, it seems plainly obvious that a new version of GTA Online is coming. According to multiple reports, the new version of GTA Online for GTA 6 could launch in 2027 , along with a PC edition of the game .

GTA Online for GTA 5 has been, and continues to this day, to be a major moneymaker for Rockstar and Take-Two , and it's expected that the developer will find even more ways to make money from players with GTA 6 Online. Some have theorized that GTA 6 Online could have some form of user-generated content, for example, potentially leading to a marketplace of some kind.

GTA 6 launched on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it reached 32.5 million copies sold via pre-purchases alone . On day one, GTA 6 generated $3.79 billion in revenue . Over the first four days, GTA 6 has climbed to 44.9 million copies sold and more than $4 billion in revenue , according to a report.

items.title: GTA 6 玩家发誓天气系统被破坏，最新补丁证实了这些怀疑
items.summary: Rockstar brought weather back to Leonida.

content.v: In my first 30 hours of Grand Theft Auto 6 , I think I saw it rain once. And that was during a particularly gloomy main story mission where it felt like it was intentionally flipped on and not a serendipitous moment created by the game's weather system.

I was not alone in wondering what was up with the weather in Leonida. GTA 6 players have been confused by the lack of rain and fog since day one, especially after Rockstar boasted about the kind of storms and hurricanes it can create to Game Informer in September.
Apparently, the questioning was justified: The weather system was broken and should now be fixed in a new patch that went out today.

"Fixed an issue that resulted in weather not changing for extended periods," the patch notes say, confirming that, while some players witnessed changes in weather, it was not properly happening at the rate it was intended.

You don't partner with The Weather Channel to post exclusive pre-release screenshots of your game if the forecast is mostly sunny and not actually representative of Florida, the state with the most unpredictable weather in the US. GTA 6 has realistically detailed radio towers that left a TikTok guy who's worked on them in real life gobsmacked. It would've been bizarre if Rockstar neglected to put that kind of effort into a system normies like me would notice within a few hours.

The sun's reign is over and all the other meteorological conditions can take the spotlight. As someone who takes their time doing all the silly little daily routines in Jason and Lucia's life and abiding by traffic laws for the vibes, I'm excited to see how much the weather affects the mood. I'll just have to remember to be a little more discerning when chasing down one of GTA 6's cars to make sure I don't absolutely ruin the interior from a surprise storm.

items.title: 玩家发现 GTA 6 60fps 出现故障，但这只是再次确认了 Rockstar 的 30fps 上限
items.summary: One of GTA 6's biggest controversies was Rockstar's decision to keep the game's framerate locked at 30 fps, ra

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/gtavi-35-1795439002195.jpg

One of GTA 6 's biggest controversies was Rockstar's decision to keep the game's framerate locked at 30fps , rather than allowing for an unlocked mode. Over the weekend, players managed to find a glitch on Xbox Series X that lets you unlock the frame rate, albeit to mixed results.

The glitch is performed by booting up the game when the Xbox console is set to 60fps, then going into the console settings, switching the system to 120fps, launching another game, and then using Quick Resume to start GTA 6 back up. That process essentially tricks the system into unlocking the frame rate, and some people have been able to push it a bit higher than the game's default 30fps lock.

The folks over at Digital Foundry were able to put the '60fps glitch' to the test, though, and found that while you could push upwards of 60fps, it was limited to situations where, "If you look straight up in the ocean, frame-rates can just about graze 60fps."

Instead, Digital Foundry's results reaffirm Rockstar's decision to ship the game with a 30fps lock. While the game managed an average of 36fps in the first hour of the game, GTA 6 only gets more demanding as it progresses into Vice City, where NPCs and explosions are both more prevalent. And, in those situations, the game still has sharp drops to lower frame rates.

The whole reason a 30fps cap makes sense for GTA 6 is consistency. While this glitch shows that the game sometimes has the headroom to peek above 30fps, and even into the 40s, getting rid of the cap would just mean the difference between the peaks and valleys of the frame rate would be even higher, and thus more noticeable. It's no secret that the game does drop below 30 fps during heavy action or when you're speeding through the world, but any dip from 40fps to 24fps would be a lot more jarring than a dip from 30fps to 24fps.

This glitch has given some fans renewed hope that an unlocked version of the game would come out at some point, but Rockstar has been pretty clear about this generation's technical limitations. Right as GTA 6 was coming out, Rockstar technology production director Marc Chambers flat-out said that the PS5 Pro processor "is not powerful enough to run the game's complex simulation at higher frame rates." That's something I've noticed myself as I've started to cause more problems in Vice City.

Still, it would be nice to play GTA 6 at a higher frame rate, even if I have to wait for the PC version to do so. Luckily, it does seem like a PC port will be coming faster than previous entries , due to Rockstar's worry about an unofficial and AI-assisted port of the game. It's even starting to look like its fears on that front were justified .

items.title: YouTuber 发现狂野 GTA 6 复活节彩蛋，仅 3 天就破解代码，带来精彩惊喜
items.summary: A YouTuber has solved the wildest GTA 6 Easter egg puzzle yet in just three days. Here's how he did it, and wh

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/gtavi-48-1795462919278.jpg
A YouTuber has uncovered the wildest GTA 6 Easter egg yet. Following a series of arcane clues and pulling a set of switches in the correct order sees players transported back to the 1980s.
Warning! Spoilers for GTA 6 follow.

The Easter egg begins in the R&D tower in Key Lento, GTA 6’s starting area, but spans almost the entire map. Players have to pull a series of switches and press certain buttons to trigger a portal into the past, complete with new voice acting from Danny Dyer as Kent Paul.

After scaling the tower, the YouTuber ( Memeio ) noticed that a sound effect from GTA Vice City plays when he messed with the lever and button. A poster for LPL (Leonida Power and Light) in the room then guided him around Leonida to the LPL power substations dotted around the map.
Each substation contained letters written on its walls. Memeio was so committed to figuring out the mystery that he actually followed the power cables across the map to track them all down.

After putting all the letters together from all 12 substations, Memeio realized they spelled out an interesting phrase: “Life is passing me by.” That phrase was a cheat code in Vice City that sped up the in-game clock.
On PlayStation, the code for that cheat was: Circle, L1, Square, L1, Square, L1, Triangle, Circle, Triangle.

Memeio realized that he had to enter that code using all the buttons and switches at the various substations, applying a button to different lever flips and button presses. After pressing the buttons in order, without fast travelling, Memeio got an in-game text to head to Reactor 2 between 7pm and 6am. When he did, a portal opened.

Stepping through the portal transported him to Vice City’s Malibu Club, complete with polygonal graphics. Upstairs, he even saw Kent Paul, voiced by British actor Danny Dyer, reprising his role. Danny Dyer is included in the credits for GTA 6 under the “local population" category.
For all that effort, you get access to Tommy Vercetti’s iconic floral shirt and his classic Malibu bike, complete with star decals.
Here’s the clip for how he did it:

items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 features a big cast of characters with fascinating, memorable storylines, and one such char

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 features a big cast of characters with fascinating, memorable storylines, and one such character is the drug-smuggler Donnie . He's played by actor Brad Carter, and he has a captivating life story of his own

Some 13 years ago, Carter underwent brain surgery to address tremors in his hands. For his brain surgery, he needed to be awake for the best chance at success, and as a musician, he played guitar to help the surgeon place the electrodes in the right positions .

His surgery was documented live on Twitter and Vine back in 2013, and you can see some dramatic photos of the surgery on UCLA's website. The surgery, or actually the multiple surgeries he had, did not completely eliminate his tremors, but he was able to play guitar again. The story made international headlines .

Carter's role as Donnie may be the part he ends up being known best for, considering how enormous and culturally dominating GTA 6 is. But he had a long acting and music career before GTA 6, having appeared on episodes of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia, Dexter, True Blood, True Detective, Justified, Ozark, Yellowstone, and Sons of Anarchy.
GTA 6 is Carter's second big gaming role, following his portrayal of Jonah in Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption (2010).

items.summary: Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/screenshot-2026-11-23-185649-1795460219133.png
Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit.

For almost a decade, cheery Canadian streamer Nicholas " Nick Eh 30 " Amyoony has amassed a community of millions around his family-friendly Fortnite streams. His personal brand is based on pushing positivity, he's known for never swearing on camera, and he's become one of the few Twitch stars partnered with Epic Games to get a skin of himself made available in-game.

So it has, understandably, come as something of a surprise to see wholesome Nick Eh 30 embracing the most dastardly deeds GTA 6 has on offer: kicking pet dogs to death in the street , shooting animals in the zoo , and walking down the length of a train executing every passenger at point blank range .

As someone who has followed Nick Eh 30 for a while, seeing him wandering around GTA 6's world eliminating swathes of its animal population while chuckling to himself is indeed odd to see. Social media is awash with similar reactions, with posts from his followers stating things like: "IN WHAT UNIVERSE DO YOU NEED TO BE DOING THIS" and "Years of building ramps in Fortnite could not prepare chat for this."

But this is all clearly intentional, down to his streams being labelled as humorously promising "family friendly GTA" gameplay (I'm not sure there's any such thing). And the fact this has led people to actually discuss his streams and share clips further has only proven why he's likely doing this.
NickEh30 takes a taser to the Zoo in GTA VI https://t.co/4SAVgUCjYm

All of that said, it's still a surprise to see Nick squarely aiming for the game's brutal "Irredeemable" criminal profile rating — a label that Rockstar has actually made quite difficult to achieve unless you really, really want to play the game as bloodily as possible.
It's this, seemingly, which has led to clips of Nick playing fetch with dogs using lumps of C4 , and throwing random NPCs from buildings .

items.title: 《侠盗猎车手 6》的 HDR 出现问题，但这些调整可以修复它
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games o

content.v: Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles. But it isn't without issues, especially if you're trying to experience the sights and sounds of Vice City with all the moody contrast and bright highlights that HDR offers.

That's due to an HDR calibration tool that isn't exactly working in the way that you expect it. Like many other games, GTA VI doesn't use the system-level HDR settings on either the PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S. Instead it features its own calibration tool, which lets you adjust the maximum brightness, black levels, and paper white values that work best on your display. While the tool makes calibration seem straightforward, there's an issue with it that makes it very unreliable.

Specifically, the maximum brightness and paper white point values seem to be linked in a way that is both unclear and incorrect. Normally you would set these values individually, with maximum brightness set according to the value your display supports and the paper white value that looks best to you. GTA VI instead changes the maximum peak brightness value it is storing as you change the paper white point. For example, if you set a maximum peak brightness at 1000 nits (a typical value) but then reduce the paper white point (given how how its default is), the peak brightness value reduces as well, with no indication to you that it's happening.

HDR enthusiasts and handy calibration assistors HDTVTest and GamingTech have both confirmed the issue, and provided some rough workarounds until Rockstar (hopefully) releases a fix. The idea is setting the maximum brightness value higher than your display supports, but in line with what the game is expecting based on the paper white point value to choose. It's confusing, but GamingTech has drawn up a table that might help depending on your display's specifications. HDTVTest's approach is similar but with different recommended values for both the ideal paper white point and black level values, so you'll need to do some experimenting on your end to find what suits your setup best.

Rockstar has released the first patch for GTA VI , but it mostly addresses some widespread bugs that players have been encountering since launch. HDR issues were also common at launch with Red Dead Redemption 2 but eventually were fixed sometime after, but if you're like 45 million other people and planning to explore Leonida today, then hopefully these tweaks let you get it looking its finest.

content.v: Deborah Ann Woll, who plays Faye in the upcoming God of War Laufey , is coming back to play the character again in Prime Video's God of War show.

She will star in the show alongside Dave Bautista as Kratos. Sons of Anarchy actor Ryan Hurst was originally signed on to play him, but he suffered a terrible injury and the role was recast with Bautista.
Woll was the leading choice to play Faye, Deadline reported ., though other names that might have been in the mix are not available.
Ólafur Darri Ólafsson (Severance) will play Thor in the God of War TV show , taking over for Hurst, who played Thor in the latest God of War games.

The God of War cast also includes Teresa Palmer as Sif, Max Parker as Heimdall, Mandy Patinkin as Odin, and Alastair Duncan as Memir, reprising his role from God of War Ragnarok. Callum Vinson plays Atreus.
The God of War TV show will follow some of the events of 2018’s God of War and 2022’s God of War Ragnarok, telling the father-son story of Kratos and Atreus.
As for the game series, God of War Laufey was recently delayed to May 2027 . A new Kratos-led game is coming after that, and it will pick up where Laufey left off .

items.title: 前《龙腾世纪》老板质疑 BioWare 是否应该成为“单一项目工作室”，放弃《质量效应》或《龙腾世纪》以生存 EA
items.summary: "There are lots of studios within EA that did that and it didn't work—they still got murdered in their sleep."

content.v: Many are asking themselves how a legendary studio like BioWare, which is responsible for staples of the PC gaming genre like Neverwinter Nights , Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , and the OG Baldur's Gate , alongside Mass Effect and Dragon Age , can be shuttered.

Former Dragon Age executive producer Mark Darrah has already explained how the studio was backed into a corner by EA. Escalating financial pressure led to the poor decisions and subpar games we saw ahead of BioWare's closure. But what if it had all gone differently? Despite everything, Darrah does question whether there was a way for BioWare to survive under EA.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4afVeFvJuv8bZQ9DxYcQuZ-1920-80.jpg

"BioWare's entire existence under EA—it was essentially zero sum, if somebody was getting resources it was coming at the expense of somebody else," Darrah explains. "It's almost like BioWare has run exactly the same way for its entire existence. But the external constraints were different. So in the early days when BioWare needed more people it hired more people. That's like Baldur's Gate 1, Neverwinter Nights, in the early days when we have all these different threads and branches.

"And then in 2007/2008, when the EA constraints come in, the same desires are there, we need more people to ship our games so the way we fix that in that time period is by cutting off all those other branches. So [Jade Empire sequel] Revolver goes away and the Handheld [Development] Group goes away … and so Dragon Age and Mass Effect eats everything."

The alternative? Scaling things down to meet EA's needs. "Budgets keep going up, but we're still not getting bigger… So what's happening is that the walls are closing in and we're trying to be three things [SWTOR, Mass Effect, Dragon Age] and arguably we can only afford to be two things, or one thing." There's no telling whether this would've saved BioWare, but it has worked for other studios.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QgTXe6UiLfo6ypVyNrvKz8-1920-80.jpg

"Maxis figured out how to live inside of EA and BioWare never did," Darrah adds. Focusing on just one project does seem to be the answer, or at least Darrah believes it has been for Maxis and Battlefield Studios, which both had games that initially underperformed and weren't well received. "If [Battlefield Studios] don't work on Battlefield then you might as well shut the studio down. So they all work on Battlefield 4 and they fix Battlefield 4 and it becomes successful, like very successful after the fact. The Sims 4, same thing."

On the other hand "Mass Effect Andromeda ships and then Dragon Age 4 which has been starving for resources is like 'No, no [the devs] are supposed to come to us. Where are they?' That need to keep them in place isn't there in the same way. So when I say BioWare didn't adapt to EA, that's what I mean."

items.summary: The notorious GTA 6 leaker called it "an early Christmas gift."

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek appears to have followed through on their threat to release the executable of the Xbox build of GTA 6 they put into the wild last week, calling it "an early Christmas gift" for followers and explicitly linking the leak to efforts to recreate the game on PC: "The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects."

Cyberleek released a near-complete build of GTA 6 late last week, holding back only the main exe—the part that makes everything else run, basically—until either their crypto coin achieved a $15 million market cap, or November 23, whichever came first. The crypto missed badly, but time marches on, and so here we are.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/f4SX4ZkHU5hwD5FwPcFkWR-1920-80.jpg

The release of the exe, naturally, includes a call for more "donations" in its readme file (via Reddit ) which Cyberleek said will go toward a secretive project "for the gamers." They also taunted Take-Two Interactive's efforts to track them down : "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving. No budget makes a lock unbreakable, and no court order deletes what the internet already has."

Leaks in the game industry aren't anything new, but this case is unique: GTA 6, effectively the biggest videogame of all time, still hasn't been announced for PC, as is Take-Two's way . But the advent of AI means the game could be emulated on our platform far more quickly than was possible in the past—some modders estimated it could happen within a week.
One of the leads on the Leonida recomp project predicted that things will start to move quickly from here:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/joKHWDYBUjLmLkmDpWkqHR-1920-80.png
At the same time, Shayder tempered expectations in a message on the Leonida Discord, saying "it will take at least a week" for the project to reach the point where GTA will be playable on PC.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2ayaw8i3MdLMSZgijZdWgR-1920-80.jpg

How that unofficial emulated made-with-AI build would compare to the real deal is an open question, and I strongly suspect the answer will be "not well," but even just having something GTA 6-ish playable on PC is a headache that I'm pretty sure Take-Two would rather not have to deal with. I also wonder whether it will prompt Take-Two to release GTA 6 on PC more quickly than it has with previous releases. A rumor to that effect surfaced in October and I had serious doubts, but it's possible that ongoing emulation efforts will expedite its arrival..

I haven't verified whether the released exe is legit, but the previously-released material appears to be and the general consensus is that this is too. And with that, I will remind you (yes, again) that software piracy is illegal, and shady files from strangers on the internet can contain malware.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4UAoyCLM246CLeZy7wBXb-1920-80.jpg

items.title: GTA 6：您可能错过的所有秘密控制和游戏功能
items.summary: On the surface, Grand Theft Auto 6 has a pretty standard control scheme for its protagonists. You've got every

content.v: On the surface, Grand Theft Auto 6 has a pretty standard control scheme for its protagonists. You've got everything you'd expect for exploring its open-world environment, from options to sprint to aiming your gun, but there's a whole lot more to the game when you start experimenting with the inputs. Whether you're driving or jogging, Jason and Lucia are capable of a whole lot more, and these hidden features aren't thrown at you when you start the game.

Instead, you're left to discover them as you play, and each one adds another layer of immersion to the experience. If you don't want to accidentally stumble on them, here's a closer look at every hidden gameplay feature we've discovered so far. For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.
Go into first-person mode

Want to examine the world in more detail around you? Press L2 (LT on Xbox) to highlight something, then press R3 to go into first-person mode. Ordinarily, you can't move around in this mode, but there is a glitch to force the game to lock you into first-person.
Change shoulder cameras
Not too big a fan of the default over-the-shoulder aiming in GTA 6? You can switch which shoulder you aim from during combat by holding the left button on your D-pad while aiming with L2.
Quick-swap between weapons
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-launch-screens-7-3.jpg?w=636
At the same time, you can also quick-swap between weapons by tapping Triangle/Y while aiming, allowing you to keep blastin' like you're some sort of Frank Reynolds character.
Do a combat roll!
Need to close the gap quickly and avoid taking a few lead injections? Tap X/A while aiming, and you'll do a combat roll.
Do a backflip!
To show off some athleticism, run towards water, and as you get to the edge, hold X/A on the controller to do a backflip.
Pistol-whip when you're out of bullets

Got a gun in your hand, but you're out of bullets? It turns out that firearms are still good for inflicting blunt-force trauma, as you can use the melee attack (Square on PS5, X on Xbox) to knock enemies out.
Choke enemies out

For a stealthy beatdown, start a fight in GTA 6, grapple your opponent with R2, and then hold Square/X to set them up for a chokehold. Press the indicated D-pad button on your controller, and you'll trigger the chokehold.
Chain-jump across gaps
If you're running across an area that has multiple small gaps, you can tap X to jump across and tap it again to keep your momentum going.
Your car door is also a weapon

Instead of damaging the hood of your car in GTA 6, put a dent in your door by smashing it into a pedestrian. Like melee attacks, you can hit Square/X on your controller while driving to nail an unlucky person with the door.
Your feet are technically free when you're on a bike
And if you're not in a car? You can relive your Road Rash days by hitting the melee button to kick someone instead while you scoot around on a bike.
Change how you wear your cap
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Jason_and_Lucia_20.jpg?w=636

Whether you like to wear your cap in a traditional sun-blocking style or backwards, you can swap the position of your headwear easily. Just open the items and weapon wheel by holding L1, select items, and navigate to your cap. Press X/A and you can switch styles.
Distract enemies with some whistling, which I can't do in real life

GTA 6 makes for a surprisingly good stealth game, and for those scenarios where you need to draw enemy attention, you can whistle at them. Crouch, take cover, hold L2 to aim at a target, and press Triangle/Y to whistle.
Loiter like a champ with leaning actions

One of the cooler features in GTA 6 for photography fans is the option to lean against walls and railings. When you're near a wall, you can hold Circle/B to lean against it, and when next to a railing, press L3 to rest on that structure--pretty cool for when you want to take a photograph of Jason or Lucia while they chill out. If you're on solid ground, you can also hold down Circle/B to sit down.
Choose your favorite hand

If you want Jason or Lucia to emulate your dominant hand while they're holding something, press left or right on the D-pad. You can also make them hold two items at the same time, in case you want to show off that you're one of the lucky even-handed few.
Auto-drive to destinations

One of our favorite modes in the game--especially when we want to soak in the scenery of Vice City-- auto-drive is pretty easy to miss . While you're driving, hold the down button on the D-pad, press Start to enable Cinematic Mode, and then hold Circle/B to switch to auto-drive mode. You can also set the speed between slow/normal/fast for your commute.
Quick-scan vehicles
Instead of navigating to your WAiNK app, just hold Up on your D-Pad to bring it up instantly.
Duck while driving so you can avoid being shot
You're going to be in plenty of high-speed shootouts in GTA 6, and if you want to keep your head on your shoulders, hold the Circle/B button while driving to duck down.
You have turn signals; use them

Unless you're driving the equivalent of a BMW in GTA 6, you should use turn signals. While you're in your car, tap left or right on your D-pad to use these lights. They'll also cancel automatically after you've made a turn.
Switch car headlights on and off

Want to drive in stealth mode at night? Tap the circle button to turn off your headlights. Just don't be too surprised if other motorists flash you with their lights to remind you that you're driving dark.
Leave the engine running
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-launch-screens-4-1.jpg?w=636

Want to prepare your vehicle to be in getaway mode for a heist that you're about to pull off? You can leave the engine running by double-tapping Triangle/Y as you exit your car. Just be aware that this could invite car thieves to swipe your vehicle, since you're leaving it out there and purring. If you do this while piloting a boat, it'll also sail on while you explore the deck.
Push vehicles

In case you're stuck in a ditch or out of fuel, you can push your vehicle to safety. Position yourself behind, next to, or in front of your car (or boat), and keep pushing your character into it with the left stick until they switch to a pushing animation. Hold Square/X to move the vehicle, or flip it in case it has been overturned or beached.
Leave your car door open
You can also shave valuable seconds off your getaway by keeping your car door open. As you exit your car, press triangle once.
Slide across your car hood
For some Dukes of Hazzard action, sprint towards your car, aim for the hood, and tap X to slide across it. Yeehaw .
Drop anchor

If you don't want your boat to sail away without you while you search the ocean depths for treasure, make certain that you drop anchor. Press and hold left on the D-pad while piloting a boat, navigate to the vehicle menu with the right analog stick, and choose Anchor to lower it.
Additional vehicle controls
On that note, you can also find extra vehicle controls by bringing up the radio menu (press and hold left on the D-pad), and using the right analogue stick to navigate up.
Turn radios on and off instantly

items.title: GTA 6 有一个超级马里奥兄弟的复活节彩蛋，这是一次旅行
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has plenty of fun Easter eggs --many of which tie back to earlier games in the series--but

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 has plenty of fun Easter eggs --many of which tie back to earlier games in the series--but you can also find a few nods to other megapopular game franchises hiding within the vast map of Leonida. If you take a detour along the north side of Lummox County, you'll come across an area in the woods that looks like it'd be right at home in a Super Mario Bros. game, and you can even collect two distinct caps for your troubles--which might suggest that the greater Mario multiverse theory is true after all.
How to find the GTA 6 Super Mario Bros. Easter egg in GTA 6
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Lummox-1.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Lummox-2.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Lummox-3.jpg?w=636

You can mark this location on your map , as you can find the reference to the Nintendo mascot in Lummox County. It's up north from Mount Kalaga, at the end of a twisty road that seemingly goes nowhere:
Hit the bong, dude

Once you've arrived, scout the area for a purple tarp that has a bong sitting on it. Smoke it, get high, and climb the structure in front of you. You'll notice that there's a plume of smoke coming out of the one column, and if you stand in it, an invisible block will appear above your head.
Smash the block
Jump up, and you'll smash the block. You won't get any gold coins for your trouble, but you will get a nostalgic tune and two caps that reference Nintendo's favorite plumbers, Mario and Luigi.
Collect the caps
Each cap has an initial embroidered on it: "J" for Jason, "L" for Lucia. You can add them to your collection, or leave them to gather dust; it's up to you.

As mentioned above, GTA 6 has references to a lot of pop culture. Someone at Rockstar Games is clearly a huge Dexter fan , Bigfoot is on the prowl , and I really wish I'd chosen the elevator without a killer clown inside it . For everything else on the biggest game of the year-- and maybe even the decade --check out GameSpot's GTA 6 guides hub .

items.title: 《GTA 6》最保守的秘密是其整个设计的关键
items.summary: Rockstar kept a reveal in GTA 6's prologue a secret for years, but now we all know it, it's clear how it guide

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/gta-6-secret-blogroll-1795445757736.jpg
Warning: this story contains spoilers for GTA 6’s prologue and Chapter 1.

In the final months of trailers, screenshots, and extended looks leading up to Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s launch, Rockstar was keeping a huge secret. It had revealed Jason and Lucia to the world years before and, by the summer of this year, we knew that their romantic relationship was core to the story. But until the moment the game went live, we had no idea that the pair were parents. As we all found out in the prologue, Jason and Lucia have a son, Tomás. And more than just a baby, this little infant is the key to GTA 6’s entire design ethos.

Historically, Rockstar has drawn from classic crime movie tropes to establish the themes of its stories. Tommy Vercetti cut through all in his path on his way to becoming Miami’s premier crime lord. Carl Johnson rallied the boys in the hood on his quest for revenge. And Niko Bellic put his war-honed killing skills to work on the streets of Liberty City. While there are elements of relatability in all these stories – hurt over dead mothers, discovering the lie of the American dream – you’d be in the tiny minority of players if you could claim to truly recognise the lives of GTA’s protagonists as reflections of your own timeline.

But things are different this time. As Lucia orders another free water at her local cafe, her RydeMe app notifies her that her driver account has been suspended. With the cost of living rising and the job market increasingly unstable in the real world, Lucia’s reality is just a step away from ours. As a then-single mother with a baby’s life on the line, the thing that pushes her towards serious crime isn’t the lust for power or infinite riches – it’s the simple need for survival. It’s the most relatable and realistic starting point any GTA has delivered.

Later in Chapter 1, after being introduced to Mattia and Kat and their extravagant lifestyle, we do see Lucia pine for money in a more classic GTA manner. The lure of the never-ending party is difficult to ignore after nine months behind bars. But the act that put Lucia in jail is key: before holding up the store, she ejects every bullet from her magazine and clears the pistol’s chamber. She has no intention of murder. All she wants is to afford rent and feed her baby.

Similarly, Jason is far from the hardened gangster that we’ve historically seen in GTA. While he’s more involved in the criminal scene than Lucia, for him it’s just a job. Staying away from regular employment because of his awkward military history, he finds cash-in-hand wages via Brian’s drug-running operations. While there are sparks every now and again, it’s a low-level job – practically an Amazon driver for a middleman. This helps ground Jason in a more familiar reality; he’s just looking for a simple life, emphasised by GTA 6’s encouraged morning routine of shower, coffee, and a workout.

Tomás is emblematic of all this. As the innocent emotional stake of the entire piece, he encourages a more realistic depiction of our two protagonists. And that increased realism flows into the gameplay systems, mission design, and open-world opportunities. While it would be foolish to suggest that Tomás was the idea that began GTA 6’s pursuit of incredibly detailed realism, he is the character that makes the design feel complete and authentic, despite barely being a part of the story. As such, there is a weird link between a baby and the security systems that make car theft so much more complicated than just tapping a button.

Less weird is the link between Tomás and the home improvement missions that have ruffled so many feathers among those who think every GTA game should adhere to a very particular formula. On the surface, this is Jason completing DIY tasks in order to ensure his home is ready for Lucia . Look a little deeper, though, and this is a man doing the work to prove that he’s ready to be a father to the child he’s yet to meet. The jobs themselves communicate Jason’s intentions, while the attention to detail – from the DeWalt-inspired drill to the surprisingly accurate drywall screws – demonstrates Rockstar’s dedication to a realistic recreation of reality. Of course the characters in this world would respond to their life choices with authenticity.

There are narrative justifications for practically every system, and they can all be traced back to Tomás. GTA 6 is the first in the series to use the criminal profile system , assessing your actions on a morality spectrum. As young parents fighting for a better life, it’s only natural to favour the “professional” approach of non-lethal takedowns and quiet, clean getaways – these are not people interested in staining their soul. Or are they?

Rockstar has gone to great lengths to ensure there’s always a way to handle things in your preferred manner and ensure it continues to make sense within the context of the story. Tomás is absent from the couple’s lives because he’s being looked after by Lucia’s aunt, and there are several moments throughout the first chapter where there’s the sense that Jason and Lucia could simply run away from all parental responsibilities. If that’s the thought you wish to extrapolate, then a life of bloody violent crime that pays off big makes sense. At its most nuanced, GTA 6 even argues that both intentions are true, and can do so successfully thanks to its world and characters being so three-dimensional.

Perhaps the smartest integration of Tomás into the systems is how the timeline of his birth allows for any kind of romantic entanglement between Jason and Lucia to feel authentically canon. Tomás is one year old during the events of the game. Jason and Lucia met just two years ago. Accounting for Lucia’s pregnancy, that means the couple were together for less than three months by the time Tomás was conceived. Regardless of whether you believe in love at first sight or not, Jason and Lucia were hardly a dedicated couple when a baby came into the picture. They simply hadn’t had the time. We know Lucia left Jason early on, before Tomás was born, and so by the time you pick her up from prison, they’re effectively a duo starting over for the sake of their kid.

There’s nothing about being parents that demands you be in love, and there’s nothing about their backstory that demands they nurture the flame that sparked in the moment they first met. And so the romance system , which never allows you to be awful to each other and ranges from firm friends to lusty lovers, makes perfect sense: whatever you decide for them, the pair will always be in a good place to look after Tomás, either as a loving family or respectful co-parents.

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 features a massive open world to explore, and people continue to make new discoveries, including a terrifying killer clown Easter egg.

It's been discovered that the Haymarket building in Vice Beach County features an elevator filled with balloons. That's creepy, but not the worst. However, after entering the elevators, the doors close and the balloons fall to the ground. As this is happening, carnival music begins to play.

The balloons then mysteriously float back up to the ceiling of the elevator, as the lights flicker and the music takes on an eerie tone. Then the lights go out and a killer clown with blood on his face and a knife in his hands charges at you as the lights go out. You don't die in this interaction, but maybe that's the point: to instill even more horror that makes you question if what you saw was even real.

There are lots of Easter eggs in GTA 6, including an invincible NPC who teleports and a literal Easter egg . You can also travel through time via an elaborate Easter egg . For more, check out GameSpot's rundown of all the best Easter eggs in GTA 6.
You can also check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review . If you’re just getting started with the game, be sure to read GameSpot’s top five best things to do first . The game's first patch is out now as well.
GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone , and the game has now reportedly reached 45 million units sold and $4 billion in revenue .

items.title: 法官释放 2022 年《GTA 6》大规模泄密事件背后的黑客，并发出警告：“不要让这种情况再次发生”
items.summary: The hacker behind the massive GTA 6 leak in September 2022 has been released on license with a strong warning

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/gtavi-21-1795450733593.jpg

The hacker behind the massive GTA 6 leak in September 2022 has been released on license with a strong warning from the judge. Having already served the majority of his seven year sentence, Arion Kurtaj, from Oxford in the United Kingdom, was allowed to go free, conditionally.
According to the BBC , the judge warned Kurtaj: "Don't let this happen again."

Kurtaj attempted to extort GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games in 2022. After socially engineering his way into the company Slack, the now 21-year-old threatened to release clips of the unfinished game unless Rockstar paid a ransom. He pleaded guilty to the hacking offenses , which he carried out when he was 16 and 17 years old, earlier this week.

⚖️ Arion Kurtaj, 21, has been convicted today for targeting major international companies, hacking into their private systems, stealing information and data, and causing millions of dollars in losses. 📰 https://t.co/UvJTCFWnct https://t.co/3CoLIw7dDs

Originally, Kurtaj was sentenced to an indefinite stay in a prison hospital due to his autism diagnosis. After reconsideration, he was deemed fit to stand trial and spent the remainder of his time in a traditional prison, starting in January.

With his release, Kurtaj has been given a Serious Crime Prevention Order, which restricts his interactions online, barring him from using social apps like Telegram and Discord, in an attempt to prevent him working with hacker groups. The order will last for five years.

The hack happened while Kurtaj was already under police protection in a Travelodge with his computer confiscated. During his stay, he used an Amazon Fire Stick and the hotel television to hack Rockstar, Revolut, and Uber.

The GTA 6 hack saw him steal 90 clips of an unfinished build well before Rockstar was ready to show gameplay from its anticipated open-world sequel, which launched last week. It resulted in the first major GTA 6 leak, as early gameplay footage was shared online. Here, we saw dual protagonists Jason and Lucia for the first time. These clips were shared under the online name TeaPotUberHacker. It would be over a year before Rockstar finally showed the protagonists itself, and even longer until we got an official gameplay reveal, which was only shared in August of this year.

"If Rockstar does not contact me on Telegram within 24 hours I will start releasing the source code," he said in the company Slack. When the company didn’t respond, he released the files, costing the company $5 million in damages.

items.title: 这张粉丝制作的地图展示了为什么 Queen's Domain 是真正的 GOTY，您甚至可以将保存的内容上传到其中以跟踪您需要寻找的东西
items.summary: Cartographic miracles.

content.v: The world wants me to write more about Grand Theft Auto 6 and I bravely answer "No". Last week, I obtained 50% of the endings available in Queen's Domain, the best videogame to release in the year 2026. The next 50% require, well, a lot of nook-scouring and cranny-uncovering—many more hours of gameplay which I am preserving for myself as a Christmas holiday treat.

And when I do, I suspect I might make a little (just a little) use of this rad Queen's Domain map by a creator called Leny15 . Barely a week ago I wrote that "I suspect a cross-section of [Queen's Domain's] goliath, entwined map would make for a killer bit of wall art". Well, I was right. Here it is and it looks rad as hell.

No, really. Even if you're not a Queen's Domain player—or maybe especially if you're not—take a look at this thing. It's one thing to wander these maps as a player, it's another to get a totally flexible birdseye view of how dense, twisty and interconnected they are. I will never stop being blown away by how knotty and elaborate this game is; I love it.

I will also never believe I have actually explored all of it. I'll be honest, gang, I really feel like I've plumbed the depths of this game, but this map has entries for areas I ain't even heard of, and even those areas that I have heard of seem to contain secret sub-areas I've barely touched.

My favourite feature of this thing has got to be the ability to upload your save to it, at which point it will give you a completion percentage and tick off the collectibles and secrets you've already attained (reminder that you can download your Steam cloud saves right in your browser). I was heartened to read that I have, it seems, done in about 70% of this game already. I was even more heartened to learn that the remaining 30% seems even stranger, more complicated, and more baffling than all the rest. I can't wait to check it out.

items.title: 《GTA 6》中的 60 个小时让我向往在线版的列奥尼达
items.summary: Leonida deserves to be explored with friends.

content.v: I honestly can't recall the last time I took such delight in existing within a virtual world as the way I have with Grand Theft Auto 6 's Leonida. Rockstar has delivered on its promise of both breadth and depth—the map is huge, but utterly stuffed with detail. Large, open highways shrink into single lanes surrounded by construction that force me to slam the brakes. Sidewalks sparse with pedestrians eventually lead to densely packed retail areas, restaurants, and clubs.

Pockets of culture erupt all over: the sheer redneckery of Port Gellhorn, the Latin culture that permeates Little Cuba, and the affluent snootiness of Capri that has cops flinging microaggressions in every direction. You don't need to undertake any missions in these areas to understand the people that live here—Rockstar has nailed so much of the environmental storytelling and the conversations between NPCs you'll stumble on as you roam.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Nh9DUzrb9bvja9HYzSTmvM-1920-80.png

It's a world that, when I first ventured into it, I had no interest in exploring in a multiplayer setting. I spent an ungodly amount of time in GTA 5's Online mode when it first released. I was there on the ground for its incredibly shaky launch (I made a character and then got stuck in that birdseye view loading screen for hours, incredible stuff) and continued to sink time into it over the years, particularly during Covid.

And I like it well enough, but its novelty has waned over the last decade. Its core experience is inherently different from what singleplayer brings, and I had yearned to return to a world less about blowing other players up with flying motorbikes and more about, well, blowing non-players up with regular motorbikes.

But after 60 hours roaming around Leonida and witnessing what it has to offer? I now want nothing more than for Rockstar to spin this map into the next generation of Online. Even outside of missions and driving around, there are so many little things that I would kill to do with pals.

Grab a pack of brewskis from the convenience store, hop in a boat, and go fishing. Throw on our best all-American attire and get down and dirty in some mud racing. Seek out other players meticulously planning a jewellery store hold-up, only to swoop in and steal the goods for ourselves. Hit up the gym for a little workout before nipping to a nearby restaurant for a bite to eat. Leonida is a place that is so rife with things to do, and I can imagine doing almost all of them with some buddies by my side.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/yRnewaDLb6YSuKR6wNQ6t7-1920-80.png

It's also the perfect opportunity for Rockstar to introduce things that are sorely missing for me right now. A lack of safehouses makes sense with GTA 6's offline story, but I yearn to buy highrise apartments and suburban houses. Maybe even buy a business or two, for a little side cash. There's also the matter of that gigantic casino and the go-kart track that are currently inaccessible but the latter of which is donning a large "COMING SOON" sign. It feels like I'm being taunted. Surely you wouldn't put these things in the game with no intention of opening them at some point… right?

And even as someone who was never interested in nor dabbled with GTA Online's flourishing roleplaying scene, I've encountered so many instances where I've thought roleplaying in Leonida actually be pretty darn neat. I could become a RydeMe driver, or a Snapmatic influencer, or a backwater recluse who lives off the land. And when the game comes to PC? The potential for bending the world to account for even more professions becomes all the greater.

Rockstar hasn't actually said a damn thing about GTA 6 Online right now, but it feels inevitable. Leonida is the biggest playground the developer has given players to date, and unleashing players across its sprawling map is Online's natural evolution. And, y'know, considering how much money GTAO has made over the last 13 years, I'm almost certain that Rockstar won't leave that kind of opportunity on the table.

items.title: 您需要钥匙克隆器来窃取 GTA 6 的所有车辆吗？
items.summary: You've probably noticed that many of GTA 6's more expensive cars require a key cloner to steal. Here's how to

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/23/key-cloner-blog-1795449262901.jpg

Throughout your early hours in GTA 6, you may have been faced with many vehicles that you simply aren’t equipped to steal. It can be frustrating to walk up to a nice-looking car and be faced with the prospect of not being able to drive away in it because a “key cloner” is needed. Even if some oblivious rich person happens to leave their driver’s seat door open for you to slip into, you’ll still need the required tech to start the engine. Instead, you’ll have to wait until you can start cloning keys until you can experience the full range of Vice City vehicles available to you. Here’s when you’ll get it, and how it works.

GTA 6 smartly staggers what class of car is available to you over the course of its story, minimising the risk that comes with jacking them as Jason and Lucia become smarter criminals. At first, you’ll be limited to rusty work vehicles and family sedans, but even these come with a risk. You’ll either have to steal them from somebody already driving, thus risking them alerting the cops to your crimes, or smash through a window to gain access, which is likely to raise an alarm.

Your handy “Waink” scanner app on your phone can help you work out which vehicles you should be targeting. Those with the “key cloner” symbol attached to them are pointless to go after until partway through chapter three, which we’ll get onto soon. It’s not even until chapter two, and you meet Moses, that you’ll even be able to get into low-level cars easily. Upon working with Port Gellhorn’s mechanic, he’ll gift you a slim jim, meaning car window alarms no longer have to be triggered. Still, cars with digital keys and trackers inside them are still a no-go.

In chapter three, Leonida’s full roster of vehicles will make themselves available to drive. You’ll get the key cloning device installed onto your phone during the appropriately titled “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ G” mission, from Randy, a Vice City car shop owner. We have a detailed step-by-step guide on how to get the key cloner here . Randy acts similarly to Moses as a quest giver — asking you to recover specific cars with high sell-on values — but can cash in on ones with trackers built in.

Once you’ve passed this main mission, you’ll now be able to fulfill your Grand Theft Auto fantasies and get behind the wheel of any Grotti, Pfister, or Pegassi that catches your eye. Just be aware that it won’t be simple to register these to either Jason or Lucia as personal vehicles straight away, though. Not only do they get quite expensive, but advanced trackers — GPS devices that track your location if you fall below a certain speed limit — can only be dealt with at Randy’s shop. Tick more and more cars off his desired checklist, though, and that may become a simpler process.

So, in short, yes, you can steal every car in GTA 6; you just need to wait until chapter 3 in order to do so. There’s no getting the key cloner early, as it's tied to a main mission and can’t be found in the open world beforehand. Mattia may give you a taste of that supercar life early on during chapter one, but it's well worth the wait to get your hands on one for yourself.

items.title: 等了这么久，《燕云十六声》的官方DLSS 5优化有什么不一样
items.summary: 11月24号——也就是明天，《燕云十六声》就要正式上线支持DLSS 5 的版本。对于这项技术，燕云玩家可是期待已久了。 在DLSS 5公布早期，我们就已经在NVIDIA官方列出的首批合作名单里看到《燕云十六声》的名字；每

content.v: 11月24号——也就是明天，《燕云十六声》就要正式上线支持DLSS 5 的版本。对于这项技术，燕云玩家可是期待已久了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14668/568e0b2b17b7bcdbb615f881a0632f04.jpg_mw680water
在DLSS 5公布早期，我们就已经在NVIDIA官方列出的首批合作名单里看到《燕云十六声》的名字；每次有新的DLSS 5游戏上线，也都能看到燕云玩家“催更”的身影；甚至在官方DLSS 5版本上线前，燕云的玩家社区里就已经陆续出现了各种关于DLSS 5的民间工具。
借助着NVIDIA APP和各种插件，有的玩家自己开始研究如何将渲染组件加入游戏，提前享受3D引导神经网络渲染的画质；也有人着手制作插件，对人物、衣物和环境等不同元素进行参数调整。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14668/4adb5bc08d4fa16277240b5bd822af2d.jpg_mw680water
网友用OptiScaler进行的魔改
玩家的迫切期待，或许在一定程度上加速了《燕云十六声》官方和NVIDIA之间合作的推进速度。
毕竟在官方的支持下，3D引导神经网络渲染在材质和光影上的优势才能得到更好的发挥，展现出玩家们期待的那个更真实的武侠世界。
对于DLSS 5的3D引导神经网络渲染来说，这项技术并不是重新生成一张游戏截图，因此就算玩家自己的“魔改”再好，也无法完全发挥它的优势。
在《燕云十六声》制作组的配合下，它才能以引擎生成好的画面作为基础，结合颜色、运动矢量以及其他场景底层信息，在最终渲染阶段重新计算一部分光照和材质表现，对视觉效果进行更准确的校准。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14668/bd6b60cc9b5a015db3a5807c4ec9174e.jpg_mw680water
这几天，我也提前拿到了《燕云十六声》的测试版本，用一张公版RTX 5080提前测试了DLSS 5的画面表现。
帧数表现方面，我在开启了全高画质的情况下，游戏在4K、2K和1080P画质下的原生渲染帧数分别约为48FPS、86FPS和128FPS。在打开DLSS性能模式、开启Reflex和2倍帧生成的情况下，帧数会大幅提升到115、180和220左右，肉眼已经看不出任何卡顿。
此外，我还进一步开启了6倍多帧生成模式，三个分辨率下的游戏帧率还能再次提升到330、510和600左右，已经超出了大多数显示器的刷新率。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14668/58f891db32efb323bf0a9521469eb169.jpg_mw680water
游戏实机场景
只不过比起这些帧数表现，DLSS 5的神经网络能给画质带来多大提升，才是玩家最关心的内容。
这次的设置页面里，《燕云十六声》给玩家开放的3D引导神经网络渲染调节还比较简单，主要包括色调强度、结构强度和角色强度三个选项。但就算选项不多，它依然带来了很多提升显著的画质体验。
其中最明显的，就是人物的质感。通过调整角色强度，可以让游戏中人物的面部受光和服装材质获得更加明显的变化。只要找准当前场景的光照特点，就能让人物看起来更加真实。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14668/e3b27eb28c410de19a55ddf9f09a086c.jpg_mw680water
开启 DLSS 5 后，人物皮肤的明暗过渡会更有层次感
DLSS 5带给《燕云十六声》的画质提升，并不简单来自于提高材质清晰度，而是让角色和场景能在不同的光照、材质下显得更自然。
比如在一些自然场景里，通过调节设置中的结构强度，就能控制模型之间的接触阴影、反射、环境光遮蔽等视觉细节，突出场景中物体之间的前后关系——在中式庭园审美里，景观之间的层次感同样是美感的重要来源。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14668/d02e587231098b0c616ccd6ab760f354.jpg_mw680water
由于图片大小所限，图中能看出的变化都远不如实机
DLSS 5的3D引导神经网络渲染，擅长的正是提升3D场景中光照和材质的表现力。
正因如此，《燕云十六声》这个涵盖了海量角色和场景的武侠开放世界才非常适合作为这项技术的展示窗口。人物的面部、发丝和服装，古建筑里的木材与金属，山水环境中的植被、水面和岩石，以及白天与夜晚截然不同的光照条件，都提供了大量适合发挥这些能力的场景。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14668/f3a9c640a4cc4a7798d0b10af026512c.jpg_mw680water
游戏实机截图
燕云玩家们之所以如此期待DLSS 5的上线，除了对新技术的好奇，也是想看看这个他们已经无比熟悉的庞大世界，还能拥有怎样的画面表现力上限。
这次版本上线前，我还看到有玩家担心“会不会变得太过真实”，变得不像他们熟悉的燕云了。
事实证明，DLSS 5带来的3D引导神经网络渲染并没试图改变《燕云十六声》的美术风格，只是让玩家们熟悉的角色、熟悉的套装和熟悉的建筑在光线真正落下时，看起来更像它们在这个江湖里应该有的样子。
让这个武侠世界变得更接近想象中的样子——这或许才是《燕云十六声》玩家等了这么久的 DLSS 5，最想看到的改变。
